name: Ars 'n Spells
summary: Ars ’n Spells bridges Ars Nouveau and Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks, creating deeper synergy between two major magic systems. Harness mana, spell power, glyphcraft, and spellbooks together through new compatibility features, cross-mod progression
description:
THIS PROJECT IS NO LONGER MAINTAINED. For Future Updates: [Visit Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-n-spells)

# Ars 'n' Spells

**Ars 'n' Spells** bridges [Ars Nouveau](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-nouveau) and [Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/irons-spells-n-spellbooks) into one seamless magic experience. Unify your mana, share progression between spell systems, scale your power across both mods — and even weave Ars spells into real Iron's spellbooks, cast straight from Iron's native spell wheel. All fully configurable.

Works with **Minecraft 1.20.1** on **Forge**.

---

## Requirements

| Mod | Required? |
|-----|-----------|
| **Ars Nouveau** (4.12.7+) | Yes |
| **Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks** (3.15.0 – 3.x) | No — falls back to native Ars behavior if absent. Tested against both 3.15.0 and 3.16.2. |
| **Covenant of the Seven** (Sanctified Legacy) | No — enables LP and aura ring systems (2.2.6 recommended for the aura HUD) |
| **Blood Magic** | No — optional LP source for Ring of Seven Curses |
| **Apotheosis** + **Apothic Curios** | No — lets affix/socket mana stats on curios feed the unified pool |
| **Ars Elemental** / **Too Many Glyphs** | No — supported and covered by the automated test suite |
| **JEI** / **EMI** | No — internal proxy entries are hidden from both when present |

*(Curios is required by Ars Nouveau, so it is always present.)*

---

## Mana Unification

The core of Ars 'n' Spells: **five configurable modes** that control how the two mana pools interact.

| Mode | How it works |
|------|-------------|
| **ISS Primary** *(default)* | Iron's mana is the single source of truth. Ars reads and drains from Iron's pool. |
| **Ars Primary** | Ars mana is authoritative. Iron's spells drain from Ars mana. |
| **Hybrid** | Shared bidirectional pool. Choose which HUD bar to display. |
| **Separate** | Independent pools. Cross-mod casts split costs between both (configurable split). |
| **Disabled** | No integration — each mod uses its own pool. |

Conversion rates between the two mana systems are fully configurable, and cross-system mana **regen** is unit-converted properly (Iron's percentage regen vs Ars flat regen) so stacked regen gear never spirals out of control.

The mod automatically hides the redundant mana bar so your HUD stays clean.

**Changing the mode** (applied live, no restart): in singleplayer, open Mods → Ars 'n' Spells → Config and click the **Mana Mode** row to cycle it; server operators can run `/ans mode set <mode>`; or edit the config file directly. Confirm the active mode with `/ans mode`.

---

## Gear & Spell Integration

- **Gear perks cross over** — Ars armor bonuses apply to Iron's mana pool (and vice versa), depending on your active mode.
- **Curios & Apotheosis affixes** — Mana stats on worn curios (rings, amulets, belts) cross over too, including those rolled by **Apotheosis / Apothic Curios** affixes and sockets (and by Magical Jewelry, Jewelcraft, and similar). The read is generic — no hard Apotheosis dependency — and can be turned off with the `read_curio_attribute_modifiers` config. (Combat-only stats like crit or armor pierce are not mana/spell-power and are not bridged.)
- **Spell scaling** — Ars spell potency scales with Iron's spell power attributes using additive stacking (not multiplicative). Elemental bonuses are applied based on your first glyph. A configurable `spell_power_cap` (default 3.0) prevents extreme values.
- **Enchantments** — Mana-related enchantments from both mods are respected regardless of which pool is active.

---

## Resonance

When your mana is nearly full (above 95% by default), you gain a **Resonance bonus** that boosts spell damage. A reward for mana-efficient play. Configurable per mod, with adjustable strength, linger duration, and a damage cap.

---

## Source Jar Synergy

Standing near Ars Nouveau Source Jars passively boosts your mana regeneration. The bonus is configurable via `source_jar_synergy_multiplier` (default 5.0), with tunable scan interval and radius plus a dedicated off switch (`enable_source_jar_synergy`). The scan is position-cached for performance and never force-loads chunks.

---

## Cross-Mod Progression & Affinity

- **Progression sharing** — Casting Ars spells grants Iron's school progression, and vice versa.
- **Affinity tracking** — The mod tracks your spell school usage over time, with optional decay for unused schools.

---

## Cross-Spell Inscription

Cast spells from *either* mod using items from the *other* mod through a tablet-driven inscribe / uninscribe ritual flow. Both ritual tablets are crafted at the **Enchanting Apparatus** and are fully datapack-defined, so pack authors can retune ingredients without code.

### Spell Transcription — bind a foreign spell onto an item

1. **Craft the Spell Transcription tablet.** Reagent: a novice Ars Nouveau spellbook. Pedestals: any tiered Iron's spellbook, an archwood log, and a source gem block. Costs 2000 source.
2. **Set up the brazier.** Place the tablet on a Ritual Brazier and drop two items within ~3 blocks:
   - exactly one **source** — a filled Ars Nouveau spell parchment, focus, or spellbook, or an Iron's Spellbooks scroll
   - exactly one blank **target** item to receive the inscription
3. **Activate.** Strict disambiguation: more than one of either category, or any already-inscribed item in range, fails the ritual with a chat message that names the items it saw and the rule. Items that already carry an Ars Nouveau spell at root NBT are rejected as targets so right-click resolution stays unambiguous. On success the source is consumed, the target gains the cross-cast inscription, and a binding theme of enchantment-glyph particles + the enchantment-table sound marks the inscribe.
4. **Cast.** Right-click the target. Sneak-right-click cycles between multiple inscriptions on the same item.

Mana costs flow through the active unification mode and respect your configured conversion rates. In **Separate** mode, costs split between both pools according to your dual-cost percentages. Cross-cast spells pay an overhead set by `cross_cast_cost_multiplier` (default 1.25 = 25% extra) — applied symmetrically to both directions, once per cast, before mana deduction.

### Spell Uninscription — strip an inscription cleanly

If you change your mind, the **Spell Uninscription** ritual returns an inscribed item to a bit-identical fresh-blank state so it can be re-inscribed cleanly.

1. **Craft the Spell Uninscription tablet.** Reagent: a blank parchment. Pedestals: a water bucket, a source gem, and an archwood log. 500 source.
2. **Activate** with exactly one inscribed item in range and nothing else — sources or stray blanks fail the ritual rather than risk stripping the wrong stack.
3. The cross-cast NBT is removed cleanly (spells list, cycle index, and any empty residual tag), with an ash + smoke dissolution theme.

The uninscribe ritual works without Iron's Spellbooks loaded, so legacy inscribed items can still be cleaned up after Iron's is removed.

---

## The Spell Loom — Export Ars Spells into Iron's Spellbooks *(3.0.0)*

Design a spell with Ars Nouveau's tools, weave it onto a **real Iron's scroll** at the Spell Loom, bind it into a **real Iron's spellbook** — and cast it from **Iron's own native spell wheel**, right alongside your Iron's spells. The Ars spell rides as an Ars 'n' Spells sidecar on the real Iron item, so the book's own Iron's spells are never touched. This leg requires Iron's Spellbooks.

1. **Weave.** Craft the **Spell Loom** (gold ingot, 2× lapis, a book, and 3× obsidian on a crafting table) and right-click it. Drop your Ars spell source (parchment, focus, or spellbook) and a **blank Iron's scroll** into the slots, then give your spell a **name**, pick a **nature**, choose an **icon**, and press **Inscribe**. Out comes a real Iron's scroll carrying your spell. *(Ops can also use `/ans export_to_irons_scroll` for a quick, metadata-free export.)*
2. **Bind.** Run the **Spellbook Binding** ritual (its apparatus tablet appears only when Iron's is installed — 2500 source), or hold both and run `/ans bind_scroll_to_irons_book`. The ritual works on **dropped items, not your inventory**: throw the scroll and an Iron's spellbook on the ground within **three blocks** of the brazier, then right-click the brazier with an **empty hand** to light it. Nothing else may be lying in that radius — a single stray item aborts the ritual rather than risk binding the wrong stack. The scroll is consumed and the spell is appended to the book with your chosen name and icon; re-binding the same spell is rejected (dedup by spell payload).

   > ⚠️ **Not Ars Nouveau's own "Binding" ritual.** Ars ships a ritual named literally **Binding**, which makes Bound Scripts for familiars and ignores scrolls. You want **Spellbook Binding**.
3. **Cast.** Your Ars spell shows up as its **own entry in Iron's native spell-selection wheel**. Select it and right-click like any Iron's spell — it casts the real Ars spell through the full cross-cast pipeline (mana mode, cost multiplier, scaling, cooldowns). Up to **8** Ars spells per book, and your native Iron's spells cast exactly as before.

Pack authors: gate the whole feature with `allow_ars_spells_in_irons_spellbooks`, or cap spells per book with `max_ars_cross_spells_per_irons_spellbook`.

*(Generic inscribed items that aren't Iron's spellbooks still cast via right-click, with sneak-right-click to cycle.)*

---

## Unified Cooldowns

An optional system that groups similar spells across both mods into shared cooldown categories. Prevents spell spam by locking out related spells when one is cast. Disabled by default.

---

## Covenant of the Seven Integration

When **Covenant of the Seven** (Sanctified Legacy) is installed, two powerful ring systems unlock.

### Ring of Seven Curses — Life Point Casting

Wearing the Cursed Ring converts all mana costs into **Life Points (LP)**.

- **Blood Magic Priority** *(default)* — Draws LP from Blood Magic's Soul Network first, falls back to player health.
- **Blood Magic Only** — Soul Network only.
- **Health Only** — Always costs health (100 LP = 5 hearts).

If you run out of LP:
- **Safe Mode** *(default)* — Spell is cancelled, you take minor damage (you will never die from this).
- **Death Mode** — The spell casts... but it kills you.

LP costs scale with configurable base multipliers, per-tier scaling for Ars glyphs, and per-level plus rarity scaling for Iron's spells. The whole system has a master toggle (`enable_lp_system`) that every LP path honors — scrolls included.

### Ring of Seven Virtues — Aura Casting

Wearing the Virtue Ring converts your **Ars** mana costs into **Aura** — Covenant of the Seven's own regenerating resource, complete with its own HUD bar. Covenant owns the pool, regen, and persistence; Ars 'n' Spells simply maps the mana cost onto it, scaled by `ars_virtue_aura_multiplier`. Iron's spells under the ring are handled natively by Covenant. If you run dry, the spell simply fails.

**Ring Conflict:** Wearing both rings at the same time cancels both effects — you'll use normal mana instead, and receive a warning notification.

### Blasphemy Curios — School Discounts

Thirteen Blasphemy curio variants (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Holy, Ender, Blood, Evocation, Nature, Eldritch, Aqua, Geo, Wind, Dormant) each provide:

- **15% base mana discount** on all spells
- **+10% bonus** when the spell's school matches the curio's element (25% total)

Discounts stack multiplicatively with ring costs, and a matching Blasphemy also deeply discounts LP costs (`blasphemy_lp_discount`, default 85% off).

---

## Scroll Cost Enforcement

Iron's Spellbooks scrolls respect your resource costs. **This has only actually worked since 3.2.1** — in every earlier build the enforcement silently did nothing and scrolls cast for free.

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| **Full** *(default)* | Scrolls consume mana and LP/aura like normal casting. |
| **LP Only** | Scrolls are mana-free, but LP is still consumed for Cursed Ring wearers. |
| **Free** | No resource cost for scrolls (LP from Cursed Ring still applies). |

---

## Configuration

Everything is configurable via the per-world server config `<world>/serverconfig/ars_n_spells-server.toml` (server-authoritative and auto-synced — on multiplayer the in-game config screen is read-only). Major options include:

- **Master toggles** for mana unification, resonance, cooldowns, progression, affinity, LP, and aura
- **Mana conversion rates**, dual-cost split percentages, and cross-system regen conversion
- **LP system** — source mode, death penalty, base/tier/rarity multipliers, minimum costs
- **Aura system** — master toggle and mana→aura cost multiplier (the pool itself belongs to Covenant)
- **Curio discounts** — base discount, matching-school bonus, Blasphemy LP discount
- **Curio attribute bridge** — `read_curio_attribute_modifiers` (default on): mirror Apotheosis/Apothic Curios affix & socket mana stats across the unified pool
- **Spell scaling** — power cap for Iron's attribute stacking
- **Source Jar synergy** — off switch, regen multiplier, scan interval and radius
- **Cross-casting** — cost multiplier, spellbook-binding toggle, and per-book spell cap
- **Scroll cost mode**
- **Debug mode** with end-to-end cross-cast tracing for troubleshooting

All options ship with balanced defaults — install and play, or fine-tune to your liking.

---

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|------------|-------------|
| `/ans mode` | -- | Show current mana unification mode |
| `/ans mode set <mode>` | Op 2 | Switch the mana unification mode live (no restart) |
| `/ans mana getdefault` | -- | View the current default max mana |
| `/ans mana setdefault <value>` | Op 2 | Set the default max mana |
| `/ans info <player>` | Op 2 | Show mana, aura, resonance, and ring status |
| `/ans debug` | Op 2 | Toggle debug mode at runtime |
| `/ans aura` | -- | Show your own current aura |
| `/ans export_to_irons_scroll` | Op 2 | Export the held Ars spell onto a real Iron's scroll — the **Spell Loom** is the survival route |
| `/ans bind_scroll_to_irons_book` | Op 2 | Bind a held exported scroll into a held Iron's spellbook |

---

## FAQ / Troubleshooting

**Q: Ars mana isn't changing in ISS Primary mode.**
A: Make sure Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (3.15.0+) is installed. Check logs for mixin load failures.

**Q: I can't craft the Spell Transcription or Spellbook Binding tablet.**
A: Fixed in 3.0.1 — update the mod. The recipes accept any tiered Iron's spellbook.

**Q: My game crashes when I put an exported scroll in Iron's Inscription Table.**
A: Fixed in 3.1.0. Older scrolls are repaired automatically the first time the mod touches them. The Inscription Table can't read an Ars spell, so it now refuses politely — use the Spellbook Binding ritual or `/ans bind_scroll_to_irons_book` instead.

**Q: A spell in my wheel does nothing when I select it.**
A: If you unbound it earlier, that's a leftover ghost entry from a pre-3.1.0 version; bind anything to that book and it gets cleaned up. Otherwise check the log for `ars_cross_` warnings, which name the exact cause.

**Q: I see weird `ars_cross_1` scrolls in JEI/EMI.**
A: Fixed in 3.1.0 — those are internal plumbing and are now hidden from recipe viewers and the creative menu.

**Q: My Ars spells cost nothing while wearing the Ring of Seven Virtues.**
A: Fixed in 3.1.0. With `enable_virtue_aura_system` disabled, nothing was charging aura *or* mana. Normal mana is now used, as the setting describes.

**Q: An addon glyph is treated as the wrong element.**
A: Override it with a datapack — no mod update needed. See the *Spell schools* section of the README.

**Q: I see two mana bars.**
A: Verify your mana mode is set correctly. Check for overlay conflicts from other UI mods.

**Q: "Insufficient LP" even though I have enough hearts.**
A: Make sure `lp_source_mode` isn't set to `BLOOD_MAGIC_ONLY` without Blood Magic installed. The default (`BLOOD_MAGIC_PRIORITY`) falls back to health.

**Q: Scrolls are casting for free.**
A: Check that `scroll_cost_mode` is set to `full` (the default).

---

### Structures
* Ruined Warp Portals - A Warp Portal variant of the Ruined Portals that include an Explorer's Warp Scroll to help you discover new places.
* Nexus Tower - A wizard tower that allows for easier teleportation around your world.

### Glyphs
* Retaliate (Form) - Cast a spell targeting the entity that last hit you within the last 5 seconds.
* Mark (Effect) - Store a reference to a target block or entity inside a Reliquary
* Recall (Form) - Use a reference from a Reliquary to cast a spell on the target block or entity

### Functionality
* (Stabilized) Warp Index - Allows remote access to your Storage Lecterns. The upgraded versions allows cross-dimensional access.
* Ender Source Jar - An Ender Chest for Source. Place one in your base to fill up with source and take another with you to access it anywhere.
* Codex Entry (Lost, Ancient variants) - Teaches a random glyph of it's corresponding tier. Tier 1 is obtainable in basic dungeon loot. Higher tiers are unobtainable by default.
* Ritual of Arcane Permanent - A ritual to chunkload your surrounding area, fully configurable and disabled by default.
* Unstable Reliquary - An item used with the Mark and Recall glyphs, to store references to blocks, entities or players.

* Ars-themed Lanterns - Standard Lanterns with Ars themed casings - Golden, Archwood, Sourcestone, Polished Sourcestone

description:
[![](https://ars.guide/banner.gif)](https://jarva.bloom.host/)

Ars Artifice is an addon to the popular magic mod [Ars Nouveau](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-nouveau).

Ars Artifice focuses primarily on a new Artificing mechanic, allowing players to create curios that automatically cast spells when certain events effect the player.

There's currently 4 artifice methods introduced:
* Anguish - Triggers when taking a modifiable amount of damage
* Falling - Triggers when falling a modifiable distance
* Landing - Triggers after falling a modifiable distance
* Interval - Triggers on a loop after a modifiable amount of time

There are also 3 new curios introduced that allow Artifice methods to be inscribed:
* Ring, Amulet and Belt of Spell Storing

To get started with Artificing:
1. Craft an Artificer's Workbench
2. Learn the glyphs for the artifice methods using the Scribe's Table
3. Craft a Curio of Spell Storing and use it on the Artificer's Workbench, this will allow you to program in the event for when a spell should trigger.
4. Take the Curio of Spell Storing and place it inside the Scribe's Table to scribe the spell you want to be cast into it. 

Once you equip the Curio it should all start working.

Finally Ars Artifice introduces a consumable spell casting item called a Spell Gem. Spell Gems allow you to cast spells without consuming your own mana bar. Spell Gems have 3 tiers, increasing the amount of mana available within each Spell Gem before they break.

description:
# An addon for Ars Nouveau that enables full skyblock compatibility!

## Rituals
- **Ritual of Conjure Starter Island** - Creates an island from a configurable structure file. Used for map authors to allow players to build their island with a brazier.
- **Ritual of Sedimentation** - Generates cobblestone from water source blocks.
- **Ritual of Blazing/Vexing/Flourishing/Cascading Island** - Generates unique archwood islands, containing otherwise unobtainable resources. Used as milestone progressions.
- **Ritual of Elder Summon** - Summons waves of Guardians or Elder Guardian when augmented.
- **Ritual of Mana Regeneration** - Grants mana regen 1 to nearby players.
- **Ritual of Conjure Island: Deep Dark** - Creates an island of sculk, converting the area to Deep Dark.
- **Ritual of Conjure End Portal** - Creates an island containing the end portal.
- **Ritual of Conjure Geode** - Creates an amethyst geode.

## Recipes
- Crush now acts as a typical skyblock hammer and adds ore drops to cobblestone/gravel/sand loot tables.
- Heart of the sea recipe.
- Swift sneak enchantment recipes.

## How to Use
To play a full skyblock with the provided changes, players will need access to a water source (Conjure Water), Crush, and a Casting Item (book, wand, etc.). Glyphs can be configured in the Ars Nouveau configs.

## Ideas for Use
- Reduce player Regen and grant an early Ritual of Mana Regeneration. This forces the player to build a regeneration network early, or play around a central point to cast spells.
- Provide the Ritual of Sedimentation along with Crush and Conjure Water (set to Tier 1) for generating ores.
- Start the player on a small patch of land with a brazier and Tablet of Conjure Starter Island. You can change the starting structure with a datapack, or use the provided one with the above changes.
- Use Ars Nouveau's Conjure Island rituals to encourage the player to build grassy sky islands and biomes.

name: Ars Controle
summary: Addon for Ars Nouveau focused on increasing control.
description:
# Ars Controle

Addon for Ars Nouveau focused on increasing control.

## Translations

Help to translate this mod with [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/ars-controle).  
If your language is unavailable, feel free to request it!

## Content

### Blocks

#### Warping Spell Prism ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/block/warping_spell_prism.png?raw=true)

The Warping Spell Prism allows you to warp a spell projectile to anywhere in the world, even across dimensions!

It is also configurable through CC: Tweaked (though only for block positions, not entities), allowing for advanced
setups.

#### Scryer's Linkage

The Scryer's Linkage links to another block, allowing machines to interact with its linked block from distance places.

It is capable of linking items, liquids, energy, redstone, and a few other things.

To configure it, use a Dominion Wand first on the block you want to link to, then the linkage.

#### Temporal Stability Sensor ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/block/temporal_stability_sensor.png?raw=true)

The Temporal Stability Sensor shows how unstable the time of the world is. 

Using a comparator, you can find out how close the world is to lagging, 
with higher redstone output meaning the world is closer to lagging. 

You can use this to turn off farms automatically to prevent the server from lagging.

#### Warp Scroll Holder

The Warp Scroll Holder allows you to easily open and close warp portals to your desired destinations. 

Simply replace one of your portal frames with a Warp Scroll Holder in an appropriate direction and
insert a Warp Scroll while having some Source within 10 blocks (Manhattan distance).

### Items

#### Remote ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/remote.png?raw=true)

The Remote lets you remotely configure blocks and entities that the Dominion Wand can.

It has two radial menus, one for configuring which end of the connection is locked (first or second) accessible when holding Shift,
and another for the mode of selection (single or multiple) accessible when not holding Shift.

To use it, first crouch and use it on the thing you would like to configure.
Then, you can use it again on other blocks or entities depending on what the thing you are configuring accepts.

For example, selecting a Storage Lectern with Locking Last allows you to link inventories with ease.
Selecting a Starbuncle with Locking First would let you select many inventories to deposit items to.
When you are finished, left clicking air will clear the Remote's target.

#### Portable Brazier Relay

The Portable Brazier Relay allows you to carry the effects of a ritual on you.
This requires the ritual brazier to stay loaded and have a supply of source.

Now you can carry a Flight ritual to have flight anywhere you go, a Sanctuary ritual to have an easier time
exploring at night, a Conjure Island ritual for no reason at all, or a variety of other useful or silly combinations.

### Adaptive Filters

Adaptive filters adapt other filters to change or combine their behaviours in various ways.

#### Unary Filters
Filter: NOT ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_not.png?raw=true)
- Only resolves the spell if the result of the next Filter is false.

#### Binary Filters
Filter: OR ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_or.png?raw=true)
- Only resolves the spell if either of the next 2 Filters are true.

Filter: XOR ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_xor.png?raw=true)
- Only resolves the spell if only one of the next 2 Filters are true.

Filter: XNOR ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_xnor.png?raw=true)  
- Only resolves the spell if the result of both the next 2 Filters are equal.

### Other Glyphs

#### Y-Level Filters

Filter: Above ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_above.png?raw=true)
- Only resolves the spell above the caster.

Filter: Level ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_level.png?raw=true)
- Only resolves the spell at the caster's elevation.

Filter: Below ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_below.png?raw=true)
- Only resolves the spell below the caster.

Filter: Random ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_filter_random.png?raw=true)  
- Has a base 50% chance of resolving. If amplified overall, chance will be `(100% - 50% / (2 ^ Amplification))`. If dampened overall, chance will be `(50% / (2 ^ Dampening))`

#### Effect Glyphs

Precise Delay ![](https://github.com/Vonr/Ars-Controle/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/ars_controle/textures/item/glyph_precise_delay.png?raw=true)  
- Delays the remainder of the spell by `(2 ^ Extend Time Augments)` ticks

![Replac![cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15fdcc06ea4be6981d8a06ca1ef8703532bcfaa5.png)e this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6617328e3f8adbab9437b96a0d0dd03455c0dd22_0.webp)

Mana interoperability between Botania and Ars Nouveau

## Features
![intro](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b640682c5323c950a7b510880bb44d9a6164ffe_0.webp)

This mod adds the following features:

+ Ars Nouveau's source jars can bind to Botania's generating flowers/mana spreaders
+ Ars Nouveau's mana relays can transfer mana between mana pools
+ Mana spreaders can shoot mana into source jars
+ Mana tunnels can directly store mana into mana pools
+ Ars Nouveau's spellbooks can use mana items as mana sources (configurable)
+ Botania items can use Ars Nouveau's player mana (configurable)
+ Ars Nouveau's mana recovery can charge Botania's mana items (configurable)
+ AE2's ME source jars/fluix mana pools can access both mana types

## Configuration
```toml
# How much Botania mana equals 1 Ars Nouveau mana for block conversions (e.g. Mana Pool -> Source Jar)
mana_convert = 15.0
# Maximum transfer rate of mana relays between Botania blocks (in Ars Nouveau mana units)
max_rate = 1000

[player_mana_convert]
# Enable player mana conversion
enable = true
# Conversion rate when needing Ars Nouveau mana or storing as Botania mana
a2b = 4.0
# Conversion rate when needing Botania mana or storing as Ars Nouveau mana
b2a = 0.006
# Allow player mana recovery to charge Botania items
charge = true
```

name: Better End Fix
summary: Stopping LionfishAPI from messing up Better End's terrain gen
description:
## **The Issue**

If you use [BetterEnd (Forge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend-forge) alongside [LionFish API](https://modrinth.com/mod/lionfish-api), you will notice that if you use the custom terrain generator (enabled by default if you use this mod), the custom terrain does not generate and the biome source gets completely messed up.

NOTE: This problem ONLY exist if you use the custom terrain generator which adds height variation to the end islands. It does not appear to exist with vanilla minecraft terrain.

**BetterEnd Fix is NOT needed for 1.21+ as Lionfish API no longer have the intrusive biome config system.**

## **The Fix**

This mod simply blocks LionfishAPI's biome system only for the End dimension since I have not encountered any problems for other dimensions. From my testing, this has not caused any problems but if you end up with missing biomes that depend on LionFish API's biome slice features, you should make sure to add it's biomes to [BCLib (Forge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/bclib-forge) biome configs to let BetterEnd handle the generation.

## **Modpack Use**

Feel free to include this mod in your own packs. Just don’t expect full support since I don’t mod Minecraft regularly.

name: Better Fusion Reactor for Mekanism
summary: More challenging and realistic fusion reaction
description:
Better Fusion Reactor is an addon for Mekanism Generators


Supported versions: 1.12.2, 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.19.2

The idea behind this addon is to bring Fusion Reactor from Mekanism a bit more realistic and more challenging to manage.


In real life fusion reaction is very difficult thing and humanity is not yet achieved stable long-term reaction.

By installing this addon you will have to control certain parameters of Fusion Reactor with redstone, computers or manually.

And as higher temperatures as harder to maintain stable reaction.

This addon adds new UI for reactor controller and reactor logic port.

 
You will have to re-build current reactors if you have any with blocks from this mod.


What is all about?

Your task is to keep Current Reactivity (CT) as close as possible to Target Reactivity (TR)
And by that you will get better Reaction Efficiency. That means more energy output, or steam per tick, or heat.

If Efficiency less than 80%, the Error Level will grow up. And if Error Level reaches 100%, Reactor will shutdown. It also can go BOOM 💥 if that is enabled in config. (disabled by default)

If Efficiency greater than 80%, the Error Level will slowly fall down.

Keep in mind Target Reactivity is a random value between 0 and 100, and it changes periodically.

So you can't just ignite your reactor and walk away. You has to spend some time to controll it manually, or implement sort of automation logic on redstone or computers.

Pay attention to Heat Multiplier (Hm). Less value means bigger time span between Target Reactivity reset. 

And it also affects how fast Error Level changes. So for the manual control, try to keep it closer to 0.

Heat Multiplier depends on plasma temperature. Play with injection rate and you will find the best value.

It also depends on cooling type. Water cooling - less Heat Multiplier.

But if you want to get more energy, you have to automate reactor controlling.
Good Luck.



Example LUA script for OpenComputers https://github.com/igentuman/BettefFusionReactor/wiki/Simple-OpenComputers---ComputerCraft-script-for-reactor

name: BetterEnd: Before Dawn
summary: An unofficially maintained continuation of BetterEnd for Forge & Fabric 1.20.1, bringing the latest BetterEnd content alongside bug fixes, compatibility improvements, and expanded End world generation
description:
**BetterEnd (Unofficial Forge & Fabric Port) — Minecraft 1.20.1**

This project is an **unofficial port** of BetterEnd to **Forge & Fabric for Minecraft 1.20.1**.
**It includes new content from official 1.21.8+ fabric versions**, various bug fixes and optimizations.

**Required on: both client and server.**
**Requires: BCLib, WunderLib.**

**What this project does**

Adds new content to The End: new biomes, blocks, items, mobs, world generation, and exploration features (see Features below).
Forge port includes Forge/1.20.1-specific bug fixes while keeping behavior as close to upstream as possible.

## Latest BetterEnd Content on Forge & Fabric 1.20.1

BetterEnd: Before Dawn includes all new content introduced in the latest BetterEnd releases, fully adapted and backported to Minecraft Forge & Fabric 1.20.1.

## Included New Content
- Datapack-customizable loot tables for all BetterEnd mobs
- Flower Islets biome
- Waterfall Ponds biome
- Ruined End Bridges
- Dragon-Helix trees and Amaranita patches
- Reworked End lakes and biome-specific shores
- BetterEnd boats and chest boats
- End Lotus Raft
- Chiseled Bookshelves for all End wood types
- Resonance I & II Hammer Enchantments - mine 3×3×3 and 5×5×5 areas
- Infusion Ritual recipes for Resonance enchanted books
- Built-in Infusion Recipe Book
- Visual construction guides for Infusion Pedestals and Eternal Portals
- LabPBR specular textures for supported End blocks and furniture

**How this port differs from the original**

- Loader/platform: Forge & Fabric (upstream is Fabric)
- Minecraft version: 1.20.1
- Changes: Forge/Fabric/1.20.1-specific bug fixes (see list below)
- New content from official 1.21.8+ fabric versions
- Support: this is an unofficial port; upstream authors do not maintain it

**Fixes and changes in this Forge & Fabric 1.20.1 port**

- **Backport new content from official 1.21.8+ fabric versions**
- Added compatibility with the **TerraBlender** library and mods that use it (Luminous Nether, Garden of the Dead, Biomes O' Plenty, Oh The Biomes We've Gone, etc.)
- Partial compatibility with Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (C2ME) (thanks RedCraft86)
- Only use Bark wood variant for trees (thanks RedCraft86)
- Improved music system (thanks RedCraft86)
- Fix/wall plant facing crash (thanks Maeiro and magcicada)
- [Bug] The armor durability for thallasium and terminite are not working instead its a huge number that doesnt equal what the code says it should (thanks Komodile)
- [Suggestion] Thallasium is no longer treated as iron in common tags (thanks shadowwing85)
- [Suggestion] Renamed Dragonfly → Ender Dragonfly (entity + spawn egg) across all locales (thanks AcaGamer5)

**About BetterEnd**

BetterEnd expands and refreshes The End by adding new biomes and enhancing existing ones. Each biome has its own atmosphere, resources, and mobs. The mod also includes custom music, sounds, and effects to make exploration feel alive and interesting.

BetterEnd includes a custom End world generator and custom Central Island structures. With the new generator, End islands can have different shapes, terrain, and heights. Inside islands you can find caves with unique resources.

**Features**

- 24+ new biomes (more may be added later)
- 6 new mobs (with biome variations for some of them)
- Many new blocks, including 9 wood types and 7 new stone types
- Many new items, including new food sources, tools, armor, and weapons
- New mechanics like Infusion Rituals, Anvil Recipes, End tool progression, and others
- Integrations with other mods (example: 2 new sub-biomes for BYG biomes in 1.16 and some new plants for them)
- Custom End world generator (configurable) with more possibilities than vanilla
- Configs for blocks, items, mobs, enchants, and many other things

**Credits / Attribution**

Original mod (Fabric): BetterEnd by Paulev (and contributors).

Original project (upstream)

Upstream project page (Modrinth): https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend

Upstream source (GitHub): https://github.com/quiqueck/BetterEnd

**Support / Issue reports**

This is an **unofficial Forge & Fabric port**. Please **do not report** issues to the official BetterX Team’s Discord or the upstream GitHub, as they do not maintain this port.

For bugs and support related to this Forge/Fabric version, please use this port’s GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/Reijin2312/BetterEnd_Forge/issues

If any issues caused by this port affect the upstream community, please contact me directly.

description:
## Gruesome? Probably. Worth it? Definitely! [Discord](https://discord.gg/VtNrGrs)

Have you ever picked up a magic mod for Minecraft, and thought that it was too tame? Was there not enough danger involved when creating your next high-tech gadget? Bored with all of those peaceful animals just staring at you without a care in the world? Well then, I am glad you came here!  
  

Blood Magic is an arcane art that is practiced by mages who attempt to gather a vast amount of power through utilizing a forbidden material: blood. Even though it does grant a huge amount of power, every single action that is performed with this volatile magic can prove deadly. You have been warned.  
  

For the best experience, you should install [JustEnoughItems](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) to find your way through the recipes.

## Contact
Have discord? We now have a server if you want to come chat with us! [Here's the link](https://discord.gg/VtNrGrs).

## Manual and Getting Started

We now have a fully fledged in-game guidebook, the _Sanguine Scientum,_ which should provide all the information you could need. It even has a built-in getting started guide! Simply craft it with a book and a piece of glass. 

We've also taken the information in this in-game manual and transcribed it to the web - check [this document](https://dphaldes.github.io/SanguineScientium/) for an online copy. Big thanks to MystChonky for putting it together!

There are web-based mirrors of the Patchouli guide for [1.16](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bOd63XVV79AE4w0Fb1zWWha737cGXbWUFoIHhtu9cw8/edit) and [1.18/1.20](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QfCuNDqDhFuXaDBbuxe9JvgB9XSszkoUvYRPft5jMhU/edit#heading=h.bkcie2978mal) here, respectively. 

## Art
You may notice the mod has an entirely different look than you may remember. These textures were graciously provided by the [Unity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unity) team.

## Sponsored
In the market for a Minecraft server to play with some friends? Don't know how to set one up? Then consider renting an already configured server! 

[![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/2ad12511-1544-4298-959c-13a840b2653a.png)](https://bisecthosting.com/wayoftime)

If you click on the picture above and select a plan (recommended 6GB or higher for most modpacks), you can use my code **wayoftime** to get **25%** off of your first month! A small commission of the server goes towards my daily caffeine addiction, but I'd say only consider a purchase if you're already looking for a server!

## Team

#### **WayofTime**

Way works on all the cool content you get to play around with. Can usually be found making a mess for ~~Nut~~ Stella to clean up.

#### **TehNut**

Nut is retired from modding nowadays, but when he worked on Blood Magic, he was essentially a maid. He primarily worked behind the scenes, making sure the codebase itself stayed as clean and optimized as it can. He  also did most of the work involved in porting to Minecraft 1.12. Can usually be found committing code in the wrong bracing style.

#### **Yulife**

One of the art people. Currently on an extended vacation.

#### **CyanideX**

Another art person. Currently on sporadic vacations.

#### **BBoldt**

Our third art person. Currently on a permanent vacation.

#### __**VT-14**__

VT works on the fancy rendering in the in-game guide, which makes the user's life a lot easier.

#### __**Wrince**__

Wince works on the content of the in-game guide and constantly updates it when I make arbitrary changes. Recently has taken on a slightly more ~~dictatorial~~ directorial / QA role in helping with polish + porting.

#### **__MystChonky__**

A (relatively) recent addition to the team, chonky spear-headed the 1.20 port of the mod. Also fixes dumb things that I did in the past…

#### **__StellaNera__**

Stella's been pivotal in polishing up the most recent 1.20 version of the mod, fixing bugs and adding new features, and is currently working hard on porting to 1.21+. 

#### __**Firel**__

Even another art person! Made the music called "Bleeding Edge of the Hidden Realm", which is featured in the mod as a playable music disc.

## Additional information

For additional information, see the [MinecraftForum thread](https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/minecraft-mods/1290532-1-10-2-1-9-4-blood-magic-v2-1-0-65-updated-sept) or the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/blood-magic/gallery).

description:
# Blood Magic Meteors EMI Support

Adds full EMI support for Blood Magic's **Meteor Ritual (Mark of the Falling Tower)** recipes.

This addon allows you to browse every meteor recipe directly from EMI, including:

- Meteor Ritual catalyst item
- LP (Syphon) cost
- Explosion radius
- Meteor radius
- All meteor layers
- All possible blocks generated by each layer (including Forge tags)

Recipes are fully integrated with EMI:

- Search meteor recipes from the ritual catalyst.
- View every obtainable meteor block.
- Reverse lookup from generated blocks back to their corresponding meteor recipe.

## Requirements

- Blood Magic
- EMI

## Notes

Blood Magic already includes JEI integration, but **Meteor Ritual recipes are not displayed natively**. This addon fills that gap for players and modpacks using EMI.

To view the other recipe types supported by Blood Magic, you still need to install a compatible recipe viewer such as JEI or TMRV.

description:
An addon for [Blood Magic](https://modrinth.com/mod/blood-magic) that provides more integration with [Tinker's Construct](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct).

 
## 1.16+ Features
### Fluid Demonic Will

Demonic will is now a fluid and can easily be extracted from tartaric gems by right clicking on a tank or inserted into them by pouring will fluid on them in a casting table.

Demonic will can also be alloyed with blood to make life essence or liquid glass to make soul sand.

![Demon Will](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/701962fff11649236aad5c12566358b6016cff1e.png)

![Demonic Will Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/897dd573ad83a847ab0726b3b122b0dbbcd1c824.png)

 
### Blood-Seared Stone / New Tool Material Blood-Rune
![Blood-Rune](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/2f439203dca751a85ffe7184f9cd6bbbc0832672.png)

Blood-Seared stone can be alloyed from seared stone and life essence and casted into blank runes or blank slates.

It can also be turned into a new tool material Blood-Rune, which has the modifier bloodstained.

 

#### Bloodstained Tool Modifier

Tools/weapons with the bloodstained modfier repair themselves using LP from your soul network, costing less life essence the higher level they have.

 

### New Tool Material Bloodbrass

![Bloodbrass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/e557c8804ab9941bf4a58c66b70b6601bfd88cc9.png)

New alloy bloodbrass, created either by alloying molten copper and life essence or created in a tier 2 blood altar.

Tools made from bloodbrass have the exsanguinate modifier.

 

#### Exsanguinate Tool Modifier

Tools/weapons with the exsanguinate modifier add LP to your soul network whenever you slay a monster.

Adding a higher amount the higher level the tool and the higher base health the monster has.

 

### Sentient Tinkers Tools

![Sentient Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/e65d343872ca3306368c4c6c28e27001b623d915.png)

New modifier **Sentience**, added by applying a **Tartaric Gem** to your tool, makes your tool act like the sentient sword/pickaxe.

Making slain monsters drop demon will and powering up based on the amount and type of demon will you posses.

 

### Divination Rune On Your Tool

![Divination](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/5043d0453441374925c25b8a693b7ab070c7cca7.png)

New modifier **Divination**, by adding a **Divination Rune** or **Seer's Rune** to your tool, you can make it behave like the added rune, saving on inventory space and being more convenient when combined with the new materials.


![Divination](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1a7pNmC7/images/fa4356252ba2eb6e094f69d126bf6cfe1e691ef4.png)
 

Native support for Thermal Expansion and Create. With more support on the way.

 
#### 1.12

1.12 requires Atlas Lib.

It includes most of the features of the 1.16+ version minus the new modifiers and tool materials.

For similar materials I'd recommend installing Tinkering with Blood Magic.

Has support for Tinkers Complement, Blood Arsenal and Thermal Expansion, as well as limited support for Mekanism and Ender IO when Blood Arsenal is installed.

summary: BMAddon integrates Blood Magic and NeoVitae with Applied Energistics 2, adding blood-powered automation for ME networks.
description:
## BloodMagic AE2 Addition

BMAddon connects Blood Magic-style crafting with Applied Energistics 2.

The CurseForge page hosts both release lines:

*   Blood Magic builds for Minecraft 1.20.1
*   NeoVitae builds for Minecraft/NeoForge 26.1.2

The current 26.1.2 beta line is built for NeoVitae. It adds Essentia Vitae-powered automation and ME crafting support for supported NeoVitae recipes.

The mod adds a Blood Generator, which converts Forge Energy into Essentia Vitae, and an Ara Vitae Assembler, an AE2-compatible machine that can automate supported recipes directly from your ME network.

### Features

*   FE to Essentia Vitae conversion
*   AE2-compatible Ara Vitae Assembler
*   Automation for Ara Vitae recipes
*   Automation for Tabula Vitae recipes
*   Custom Blood Patterns encoded in the AE2 Pattern Encoding Terminal
*   Essentia Vitae consumption from ME fluid storage
*   Crafted results inserted back into the ME network
*   Ara Vitae Tier Cards II-V
*   Parallel Processing Card
*   Blood Speed Card
*   AE2 Speed Card support
*   Optional JEI integration
*   English and Russian localization
*   Modpack-friendly common configuration

### Blood Patterns

Use Blood Patterns to encode supported recipes. In the NeoVitae 26.1.2 beta line, place a blank Blood Pattern into the AE2 Pattern Encoding Terminal and encode a valid Ara Vitae or Tabula Vitae recipe.

Encoded patterns store the recipe type, inputs, output, required tier, Essentia Vitae cost, and recipe ID.

### BMAddon26.1.2-beta

This beta updates BMAddon for Minecraft 26.1.2, NeoForge 26.1.2, NeoVitae, and AE2 26.x.

Beta fixes include:

*   Blood Generator GUI values now update correctly on the client.
*   Encoded patterns inserted into the Ara Vitae Assembler are immediately published to ME crafting.
*   Ara Vitae Assembler GUI positioning was adjusted.
*   Encoded Blood Pattern tooltips are shorter and easier to read.

### Requirements

#### NeoVitae 26.1.2 beta

*   Minecraft 26.1.2
*   NeoForge 26.1.2
*   NeoVitae
*   Applied Energistics 2
*   Java 25

#### Blood Magic 1.20.1 builds

*   Minecraft 1.20.1
*   Forge
*   Blood Magic
*   Applied Energistics 2

Optional:

*   JEI

BMAddon brings Blood Magic and NeoVitae automation into your AE2 network while keeping fluid costs, altar tiers, and machine upgrades meaningful.

name: BloodMagic: Teams
summary: BloodMagic Teams - Integrates FTB Teams with BloodMagic. Allows players to bind blood orbs and items to their team instead of personally, so teammates can share LP networks and use each other's bound items.
description:
# Blood Magic Teams

**Share your Blood Magic network with your teammates!**

Blood Magic Teams is an addon mod that bridges [Blood Magic](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/blood-magic) and [FTB Teams](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-teams-forge), allowing players to bind their blood orbs, daggers, and other bindable items to their team instead of themselves personally.

*IMPORTANT* - This project required FTB Teams to function, you will be responsible for obtaining this mod, it's NOT included

---

## Features

### Team Binding

When you right-click an unbound Blood Magic item while on a team, you'll be presented with a choice:

- **Personal Binding** - Works exactly like vanilla Blood Magic (bound to you only)
- **Team Binding** - Binds the item to your entire team's shared LP network

### Shared LP Network

Items bound to a team can be used by any team member! This means:

- Teammates can use each other's bound blood orbs
- Sacrificial daggers can fill a shared pool
- All team members benefit from LP generation

### Remember My Choice

Don't want to see the popup every time? Check "Don't ask again" and your preference will be saved. You can always change it later with commands.

---

## Commands

`/bloodmagicteams` - Main command with subcommands:

- `/bloodmagicteams preference [personal|team]` - Set your default binding preference
- `/bloodmagicteams preference reset` - Clear saved preference and ask again
- `/bloodmagicteams status` - View your current binding settings
- These are convenience commands only, the UI handles all of this for you normally.

---

## Configuration

All features can be configured in the config file:

- Enable/disable team binding functionality
- Show/hide the binding selection UI
- Team leaders can restrict team binding via FTB Teams properties

---

## FAQ

**Q: What happens if I leave my team?**
A: Items bound to your old team will no longer work for you. You'll need to rebind them.

**Q: Can I convert a personal-bound item to team-bound?**
A: No, bindings are permanent. You'll need a new item to bind to your team.

**Q: Does this work with all Blood Magic items?**
A: Yes! Any item that implements Blood Magic's binding system (orbs, daggers, sigils, etc.) will work with team binding. Should also work for addon mods.

---

## For Modpack Makers

This mod is open for inclusion in any modpack. No need to ask permission!

---

*Perfect for multiplayer servers, SMP groups, and anyone who wants to share the blood magic experience with friends!*

name: Blue Skies
summary: Blue Skies is survival mod that adds aspects like dimensions, dungeons and more in a light and dark scenario.
description:
Blue Skies is survival mod that adds aspects like dimensions, dungeons and more in a light and dark scenario.

🍡 Requires Structure Gel API

Download it here. Structure Gel is an API mod designed to make creating structures easier on the developers, specifically ones using the jigsaw system. All code is open source and documented.


If you have any questions about the mod, please check the FAQ page, as your question is likely answered there. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/blue-skies/pages/faq

🏷️ Welcome to Blue Skies: Population

The long awaited update is finally here! Population is a huge update to Blue Skies that adds tons of new blocks, items, biomes, mobs, and 2 new dungeons! Please come and join our Discord server to learn more! https://discord.gg/WGfqqrG. This isn't all however, even more dungeons and content will come soon!



🔷 What is Blue Skies?

Blue Skies adds two dimensions called the Everbright and the Everdawn. It includes lots of new unique features, blocks, weapons, mobs and even massive dungeons! Each dimension has its own theme, with the Everbright being very bright, snowy and cold while the Everdawn is typically darker and warm. Each of these dimensions currently has two dungeons to explore, totaling up to 4 dungeons, with more planned on the way!

✔️ Getting Started

I want to play! How do I install Blue Skies? To get started, make sure that you have downloaded the latest version of the mod and you are running at least the recommended version of NeoForge to your Minecraft client. Alternatively, You can also easily install Blue Skies using the Modrinth App, if you don't have that installed already. Download it here: https://modrinth.com/app. Then, you can click here to view a guide on how to install Blue Skies with CurseForge launcher.

🔑 The Gatekeeper

Find the Gatekeeper and trade a book in exchange for his journal. You can find the houses spawning in either plains, mountains, and most snowy biomes. The Gatekeeper has extensive knowledge on these dimensions and has written all about the blocks, mobs, and dungeons found within to help guide you on your journey. You can also trade for a Zeal Lighter that works on both the Everbright and Everdawn portal frames. Check around their home as they have an unlit portal frame somewhere. As you progress through the mod, other trades may become available, so it's worth checking his offers after reaching certain milestones.



🕳️ How to Enter the Dimensions

Once you have found the Gatekeeper, be sure to trade emeralds for the Zeal Lighter to be able to light one of the portal frames. He keeps an unlit Everbright or Everdawn portal stored somewhere in his home that you can use. Once you find the portal, tidy it up, give it a light, and it should open a door to its respective dimension.

📘 Blue Journal

The Blue Journal, a book written by the Gatekeeper that's filled with information discovered from his experiences in these dimensions. The more you progress through Blue Skies, the more pages you will unlock in the journal. You only need to obtain the blue journal item once. Afterwards, you can always find access to it by opening your inventory and clicking the tab on the right with the blue journal icon.



🔊 Accessibility Reader

When enabling the narrator in Minecraft, which you can do in the accessibility settings, a speaker icon will be added to the book. Clicking this will make the narrator read the information on the page to you.



❄️ Everbright

The Everbright is a realm of eternal day and frigid cold. Home to large beasts and ethereal mobs, you'll need to keep an eye on your back as you traverse through this world. Be sure to watch out for snow storms that bring thick fog and more enemies than usual. As you explore, you'll encounter the Summoner's Blinding Dungeon and the new Nature Dungeon, home of the Starlit Crusher.



🌅 Everdawn

The Everdawn has its sun forever rising. With this being a much more humid and warm world, insects and reptiles flourish. Before entering, it's worth preparing for poison and fire as many parts of this world may inflict those on you. Venture across this diverse landscape to uncover the Alchemist's Blinding Dungeon and then the new Poison Dungeon, lair of the Arachnarch.



📖 Dungeons - Meet the Bosses!

Blue Skies is home to various bosses found within their respective dungeons. These bosses are designed for players looking for a challenge, so be sure to come prepared. If you find a dungeon that has already been conquered, attempting to activate the keystone will unlock trades with the Gatekeeper, allowing you to purchase the needed keys.

The bosses have been designed with multiplayer in mind, scaling up in difficulty with more players. Grab your friends and open the door to an epic battle!

Once you've defeated a boss, you may respawn it with the arc item obtained from it by using the arc on the keystone. Doing so will spawn the boss at a higher difficulty, which may result in better loot.

The Summoner and the Alchemist, rulers of the towers of both dimensions!

The two Blinding Dungeons found between both dimensions are home to the Summoner and the Alchemist. These bosses were balanced with mid-tier armor and weapons in mind, allowing for an early combat experience should you accept the challenge.

Residing in the Everbright, the Summoner fights with lightning, energy attacks, and his golem guards. Be sure to watch your back as these golems can quickly overwhelm you if not properly tended to. Defeating him will allow you to access the Nature Dungeon.

Found in the Everdawn, the Alchemist uses potions and physical constructs to fight. Many of his attacks can be predicted by looking out for visual queues, but missing those queues may result in heavy damage. Once defeated, you'll gain access to the Poison Dungeon.





Meet the Starlit Crusher, the boss of the Nature Dungeon!

The Nature Dungeon is a massive labyrinth consisting of 4 floors. Each floor contains one of the required keys and a staircase up to the next floor. Be sure to check every nook and cranny and to not be overrun by the Stonlets living within.

Resting at the top of the Nature Dungeon, you'll be met face to face with the Starlit Crusher. This sentient tree may not move much, but makes up for it by rooting into the ground to produce wide area attacks from below and enough brutal strength to cause the ground itself to shake. Seeing as it's still a tree, axes deal far more damage against it and are required to bypass its defenses. Look out for opportunities to stun it with a spear for an opening to attack.





The Arachnarch, the boss of the Poison Dungeon!

The Poison Dungeon is a large maze buried beneath the surface. On the surface, you'll find a large, hollowed, maple tree covered in cobwebs. Made of 4 floors, you'll need to find the key on each one and then descend to the next. Be sure not to lose your way in the spiders' nest.

Lurking in the lowest depths of the Poison Dungeon, you'll find the Arachnarch in her lair. This venomous foe lunges at targets and sprays poison from the ceiling above. Being the queen of this nest, expect reinforcements to come crawling from the walls. With such an aggressive method of attacking, you may be able to stun her when she lunges by blocking with your shield.





🔜 More to come...

Plans are aready well underway with more content planned for several updates, so be sure to stay keep up to date with what we're doing on our discord server!

🎶 Blue Skies Original Soundtrack

Blue Skies features a unique custom soundtrack crafted by Lachney! You can enjoy and download the music on your favorite platforms, including Bandcamp, Spotify, YouTube Music, and Apple Music.



🧪 Mod Support

Blue Skies adds special mod support for the following mods:

  • Xaero's Minimap by Xaero96
  • Just Enough Items (JEI) by mezz
  • Bluemap TBlueF

💖 Enjoy the mod? Support us!

If you'd like to support what we do, check out our Ko-fi https://www.ko-fi.com/moddinglegacy. Players who donate to our Ko-f will gain access to cosmetic supporter pets in Blue Skies as well as perks across other mods!

description:
![Banner](https://i.imgur.com/9ZhmIWx.png 'Banner')

**IMPORTANT! This page is under construction. We are working on a brand new, fresh and easier to use BongoWongo. The info bellow DO NOT work with actual BongoWongo version.**

**We are working as fast as we can so you can play this awesome mode!**

Welcome to BongoWongo! This modpack is a vanilla friendly bingo game with some QoL mods that will let you play with your friends at any time. For use, you just need to download this modpack, drop the contents of server file in your server and hit play. Our configs will install everything you need to start a game. You can also play in single player or open a LAN party!

# How to start a game.

Starting a game is as easy as using the Bingo Panel to select the amount of teams and then use shuffle to assign a team to each player. Then you need to hit Start in th Bingo Panel.

You can customize your game with all of the configs available, see spoiler bellow to learn each one of them!

## Customizing your games!
This is super easy thanks to Bingo Panel. Just make sure you are OP in your server in order to use it! Click buttons to set the game to your taste! Most of them are self explanatory, but if you need some help, here's a description for each button:

WARNING: there's a lot of text here, read just configs you are interested on, there's no need to learn every single one (in fact you dont need to know any of this to play!). Also in-game buttons show a little text when hovering over them :)

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### Features: customize Gamemode, KeepInventory, Starter Kits and more!

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**Lockout**: when a player has completed a task, it `locks` the item so no other team can fullfill that task.

**Inventory**: good old `KeepInventory` so you dont loose your items on death. Dont worry, there's a built in `KeepInventory` that lets you save your inventory by right clicking a bed. If you die, you will respawn in your bed with any items that you had at the moment of setting your spawn point. Also works with Anchors!

**Hidden Items**: No one knows what is in the Bingo Card! Just start playing and obtaining as much items as you can, this will put to the test your `knowledge` about Minecraft! Be careful, remember there are modded items (can be desabled, see **faltasección**).

**Consume Items**: once you obtain a bingo item, the game will `remove it from your inventory`. This makes sure you have a nice and clean inventory (most of the times hehe).

**Preview Card**: shows or hids Bingo Card.

**Elytra**: gives you an `Elytra` and some Rockets! Perfect for quick and casual games.

**Night Vision**: do I need to say any more? This gives you permanent `Night Vision`!

**Allow PvP**: enables or disables `PvP`.

**Unlock Recipes**: a simple QoL that lets you craft anything from the start, no more recipe gate keeping!

#### Spawn Kit

**Player Items**: our modpack comes with a set starter kit that you can enable using `Player Items` button. You can also create your own kit with the Edit button!

**Team Chest**: Do you want to give a starter kit for each team instead of each player? This is your button. Just as the previous option, click `Team Chest` or Edit to customize your loot!

#### Spawn Dimension
This section lets you decide in which `dimension` you want to start your game. A challenging twist!

#### Team Distance
Sets the minimum distance between teams. Be careful, higher numbers means more world to load, you will need more RAM the more chunks you set this config!

</details>

### Goals: everything about what you need to win a game

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**Goal**: you can choose between lines and items and set a number to aim to.

**Time Limit**: do you want some extra pressure? Set a max time, the game will automatically end once the time runs out! You can also disable this feature so you can have all the time you want.

**Replace Goals**: once an item or line is completed, it gets automatically replaced for another one until the set goal is completed, or the time runs out. All completed tasks are scored at the end of the game.

**Infinite**: just as the name suggest, this config lets you keep playing by replacing any completed task for another one.

**# of cards**: Game will keep going until a set number of Cards have been completed (or the timer runs out).

**End Game**: do you want to end the game when first team wins? maybe all teams need to fullfill a Bingo Card for the game to end. You can also set an infinite game by using Never option, or set a number of teams that need to win in order to stop the game.

**On stalemate**: what should happen when there's a Stalemate? Finish the game, re-roll card and keep going or just finish the game?

**Score info**: this section lets you control what displays in the right scoreboard info panel. This is a global config, meaning everyone will see this options, but you can configure your own using `Yet Another Bingo` book in your inventory!

</details>

</details>

## JourneyMap!
It is important for you to delete your JourneyMap folder inside your instance periodically. If you dont, you will start to see old map that do not correspond with your actual game. And also: keep track of your waypoints and delete them once you dont need them!

There are a lot of commands you can use, please check the official mod wiki for more info: [Yet Another Bingo Wiki](https://horrific.dev/bingo/command-cheatsheet/)

### QoL Changes
- WorldGen: you will find smaller biomes and less oceans and aquifers.
- There's a `KeepInventory` feature (if you dont have `Inventory` config enabled) that lets you 'save' your inventory when you set a new respawnpoint. If you die, you will spawn in your respawnpoint with all the items you had at the moment you saved your inventory.
- **Sleeping Bags**. You can use sleeping bags to sleep **without** changing your respawn point, perfect combination with our `Bed-KeepInventory`.
- **Backpacks!** Yes, we have backpacks, you can craft them to have a better inventory management. Be careful, more items also means more searching for useful items!
- We have both `Nature's Aura and Explorer's Compass` in game. You can use them to search biomes and structures.

### Some recommendations.
We have spend some time configurating GUI and KeyBinds features so they do not overlap. However, you can check the following features so they are just as you want!
- Combat Roll
- JourneyMap (keybinds, size and position).
- Bingo card (keybind, size and position).
- Bingo client side features: use your `Yet Another Bingo Book` in game or press Settings button in your Card Preview GUI (default jey: `Y`).
- Zoom! Yes, zoom is in this modpack.
- Ping so you can display your position to other team mates.
- Expanded Scoreboard KeyBind.
- Sophisticated Backpacks KeyBind.
- TrashSlot KeyBind.
- VoiceChat.

### It's me, hi

All my social media can be found here: [Danymaddox](https://linktr.ee/Danymaddox).

And if you like to add more gold, follow me here on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/Danymaddox) and take a look, there's more comming soon.

name: Born in Chaos Jade compat
summary: Hides infected diamond ore in Jade by displaying it as regular diamond ore
description:
The project hides infected diamond ore by displaying it in Jade as regular diamond ore.

This makes resource gathering less predictable. Players can no longer tell in advance whether the ore is safe and must take risks when mining.

For example, you may see diamond ore through Jade but won’t know if it’s infected — adding tension and an element of surprise.

This mod is perfect for players who want less “cheaty” information and a more hardcore gameplay experience.

name: Botania
summary: An innovative natural magic themed tech mod
description:
[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm0.png)](https://violetmoon.org)[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm1.png)](https://patreon.com/vazkii)[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm2.png)](https://twitter.com/vazkiimods)[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm3.png)](https://discord.gg/vm)
![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/hero/botania.png)

---

# About

Warning: Botania **Requires [Patchouli](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli) and [Curios (Forge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios) or [Trinkets (Fabric/Quilt)](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets)!**  

**Botania** is a tech mod themed around natural magic. Gameplay is centered around creating magical flowers and devices using Mana, the power of the earth. Botania is fully playable as a standalone mod (and is designed as such), but it functions just well in conjunction with other mods.

The mod focuses on automation, but without elements that make it feel grindy-- systems can be thought out and designed, rather than built blindly from blueprints in JEI or a wiki.

**Botania's design philosophy**

* No pipes, wires, etc-- they're boring and overdone;
* No GUIs-- interact with everything in-world;
* No numbers-- players shouldn't try to minmax everything;
* Keep all resources as renewable as possible;
* Provide pleasing visuals, despite using only two different particle effects.

**Botania's goals**

* Break the mold of mods being means to ends-- be engaging in gameplay as well as in rewards;
* Deliver fun and balanced gameplay without forcing players to grind;
* Incentivize sandbox gameplay and allow players to create fun contraptions;
* Create an overall immersive experience.

---

# Learn more about Botania today
### Visit the **[Official Website](https://botaniamod.net/index.html)**

---

name: Botania Backpack Upgrades
summary: Botania Backpack Upgrades is a compatibility addon for Sophisticated Backpacks and Botaniaon Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge.
description:
## Features



### Mana Tank Upgrade
- Stores up to **1,000,000 mana** by default (configurable on the server).
- Acts as a full Botania **Mana Pool** when the backpack is placed in the world.
- Accepts mana bursts from mana spreaders.
- Lets adjacent spreaders pull mana from it (place the backpack behind the spreader, just like a normal pool).
- Works with normal sparks and spark upgrades (Dispersive, Dominant, Recessive, Isolated).
- Transfer direction can be set to **Input & Output**, **Input Only**, or **Output Only**.
- Right-click the tank slot in the backpack GUI with a mana item to charge or drain it according to the current transfer mode.
- The Wand of the Forest shows the exact mana HUD when pointed at the backpack.



### Mana Supply Upgrade
- Lets compatible mana-consuming equipment carried by the player draw mana from the backpack's Mana Tank on demand.



### Mana Infusion Upgrade
- Uses the backpack's Mana Tank to convert filtered items using `botania:mana_infusion` recipes.
- Supports vanilla, data-pack, and mod-added recipes that **do not require a catalyst**.
- Pulls items from normal automation (hoppers, pipes) and has a "Works in GUI" toggle to also process items placed or moved by the player in the backpack interface.
- Includes basic filter options.



### Advanced Mana Infusion Upgrade
- Uses the backpack's Mana Tank to perform mana infusion.
- Detects the block directly below a placed backpack to enable **Alchemy Catalyst** and **Conjuration Catalyst** recipes, plus any catalyst declared by data packs.
- Has more filter slots.
- Supports filter modes by item, mod ID, or item tag.



## Known Limitations




- Dropping items on top of the placed backpack does **not** trigger infusion; only backpack inventory items are processed.
- Throwing mana items at the backpack in the world does **not** charge them; charging happens via the GUI tank slot.
- Multi-block structures that hard-code `ManaPoolBlock` / `ManaPoolBlockEntity` checks (for example the Elven Portal) are not supported. The mod does not use Mixins to fake block types.

name: Botania Seeds
summary: Growing Mystical Flowers... Botanically!
description:
# Botania Seeds

This is an Addon mod for [Botania](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania) creating growable seeds for all 16 colors of Mystical Flower. It also has several small tweaks to make acquiring Mystical Flowers slightly more difficulty.

This was originally created for the Stardew Valley style modpack [Society: Capital Hill](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/society-capital-hill), however it stands alone as a mod and will be maintained as any other. Any feedback/suggestions are appreciated!
## Features

### Mystical Flower Crops

Every type of Mystical Flower has its own seed crafted using any seed and Minecraft Dyes. These recipes can and should be modified if you plan on gating Botania in a modpack or other setting.

### Botania Tweaks

The following modifications are made to the Base Botania mod to make growing Mystical flowers make sense
- Mystical Flowers and Shimmering Mushrooms no longer spawn in the world (This can be altered using Datapacks)
- Shimmering Mushrooms now require Petals to craft, making them more decorative
- Buried Petals can no longer be bonemealed to grow into Tall Flowers, making infinite Petal duping Impossible.
## Dependencies

This mod has the following dependencies and has been tested with the following versions:

- [Botania](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania) by vazkii version 447. This mod will *likely* be compatible whenever Botania updates
## Support

Questions? Comments? Suggestions? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/GdcZkrZqkj)!

name: Botania Shader Fix
summary: Removes the GoG rainbow when shaders are loaded.
description:
# Botania Shaders Fix

This mod "fixes" a skybox rendering glitch in Botania by removing the rainbow.

In Botania: Garden of Glass the skybox has a rainbow which is rendered incorrectly with some shaders such as **Complementary Reimagined** (with **Euphoria Patches**):

![Broken rainbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ccf13218b3488e8e4a233f1a2da246a18fd76d4.jpeg)

The mod removes the rainbow from the skybox when shaders are loaded. This means that the player cannot see the rainbow with shaders, but this is preferable to it being glitched.

**It will NOT fix any other issues the skybox may have with shader packs.**

## Version

The mod is for **Minecraft 1.20.1** for **Forge** only. It depends on [**Botania**](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania) but does not require [**Oculus**](https://modrinth.com/mod/oculus) to be loaded. It will detect its presence at runtime. Other forks such as [**Mekalus**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mekalus-oculus-fork-with-fixed-mekanism-mekasuit) should also work.

**OptiFine** is not compatible.

name: Botania Slots
summary: A Quality-of-Life mod that adds dedicated Curios slots for your Mana Tablets and Rings, decluttering your inventory and reducing server lag.
description:
**Botania Slot** is a Quality-of-Life (QoL) and utility mod for Minecraft Forge that changes how you carry your mana. Instead of keeping Mana Tablets and Mana Rings taking up space in your main inventory, you can now equip them in dedicated curios slots!

---

## Overview

If you play with Botania, you know the struggle of keeping Mana Tablets, Bands of Aura, or Mana Rings in your inventory at all times just to keep your tools working.

This mod integrates directly with the **Curios API** to give you specific slots meant *only* for your mana items. It declutters your inventory, keeps your mana sources organized, and as a great bonus, makes the game run smoother.

---

## Features

* **Dedicated Mana Slots**: Adds two exclusive "Botania Mana" accessory slots to your Curios menu (identified by the Charm icon).
* **Equip Your Tablets**: You can now safely equip your **Mana Tablets** and **Mana Rings** directly into these new slots, freeing up your main inventory for loot and blocks.
* **Smart Filtering**: The custom slots are strictly filtered. Only valid mana-bearing items can be placed inside them, preventing you from accidentally storing the wrong items.
* **Performance Bonus**: Normally, Botania scans all 36 slots of your inventory every tick to find mana. By forcing the game to only check these two specific Curios slots, it drastically reduces CPU usage and server lag, making it a must-have for large modpacks.

---

## Technical Specifications

* **Minecraft Version**: 1.20.1
* **Mod Loader**: Forge 47.4.10+
* **Required Dependency**: [Curios API 5.4.1+](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) and [Botania](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania)
* **Environment**: Client and Server

---

name: Botania: Window Box
summary: A little box of flowers which attaches to the side of the house; a Botania addon.
description:
Window Box is a Botania addon mainly adding new magical flowers and other content, with the following intentions:

  • Integrating Botania with newer Minecraft updates (e.g. Oxidaisel, Candysnuft)
  • Adding functionality that I found myself wanting while playing (e.g. Snapdresson, Manastar HUD)
  • Providing options for custom scenarios like skyblock or modpacks (e.g. Groundberry, portal trees)
  • Adding things which add to the feeling of the magical/botanical theme, or just for fun (e.g. Topsy Tulip, Bouquet)


Changes to existing content:

  • Manastar: Now displays a wand HUD for its targeted pool, like the Mana Pool HUD, except displaying the overall fullness of all spark-connected pools

Functional Flowers:

  • Snapdresson: Remembers a trinket loadout. When clicked, re-equips you with those trinkets, if you have them in your inventory.
        Including within a Trinket Case or Shulker Box, etc.
  • Groundberry: Turns nearby Sand into Suspicious Sand, and Gravel into Suspicious Gravel, with the associated loot.
        Intended primarily for skyblock.
  • Oxidaisel: Rapidly oxidizes nearby copper blocks.
  • Glory Incarnata: Prevents* and reverses the zombification of Piglins, Hoglins, and Villagers.
        *except for preventing villager zombification, as this happens via death.
  • Witch's Pupil: Allows remote observation of the flower when one of its Eye Berries is plucked and eaten.
  • Dispelagonium: When splashed with a potion effect, clears that effect from nearby entities for the duration of the potion.
        Also added are potions for Wither, Mining Fatigue, and Levitation.
  • Topsy Tulip: Can be placed on any side of a block, and warps gravity to let you walk on walls.
        Requires Forge GravityAPI.

Generating Flowers:

  • Candysnuft: Generates mana when nearby candles are extinguished (consuming a candle), but only in small portion sizes (blocks of at most 3 candles).
  • Queen Anelace: Sits on a square of Grass Blocks and outputs redstone signals pointing to a block in that square; generates mana if that block (and only that block) is broken.

Magical Trees:

  • Chthonic Yew: A tree with dark black wood whose hollow contains a Nether Portal; a growable alternative to manual placement.
  • Alfthorne: A great tree with vibrant green wood whose hollow contains an Alfheim Portal. Requires the same mana infusion to open.
        Intended as options for modpack progression.

Miscellaneous:

  • Bouquet: A decorative item which can bundle up to 3 flowers together.
  • Rod of the Acropolis: A survival-friendly version of the Debug Stick which can force the shape of Stairs, Fences, Walls, and Panes.
  • Rod of the Grasslands: A simple upgrade to the Rod of the Lands which creates Grass Blocks instead of Dirt.

summary: Woot Revived Addon that add compatibility with Botania
description:
# Botania: Woot Addon

An addon for [Woot Revived](https://modrinth.com/mod/woot-revived) that add compatibility with [Botania](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania).

This addon adds compatibility with the Guardian of Gaia from Botania.

It is mandatory to kill the hard variant of the Guardian of Gaia to program the Mob Shard. That will let you get the Fake Spawner of it.

Once you have your Fake Spawner, you'll need the netherite tier of the Woot Factory for it to be valid. And then for each simulation you will need to import 1 Gaia Spirit Ingot from Botania.

It also optionally adds compatibility with the Guardian of Gaia III from [ExtraBotany](https://modrinth.com/mod/extrabotany). For this one you'll also need a Netherite tier factory but this time you will need to import 1 Challenge Ticket to simulate it.

name: BotaniaEditor
summary: A botania addon that allows to configure the mod
description:
A botania addon that changes how some of Botania's features work to allow customization.

The mod's aim is to make it easy for modpack makers to tweak values, like how much mana a flower produces or consumes, to allow a much higher degree of freedom.

It also comes with a (configurable) jade and WTHIT addon, that shows some useful info in the tooltip.

The config files are structured like this:
botania_editor-client.toml, found in the .minecraft folder, for the jade / wthit addon
various config files for specific features, found in the world folder under serverconfigs/botania_editor

**_For bugs or suggestion feel free to use github issues_**
