name: Primal Winter
summary: The entire world has been converted into a frozen wasteland with heavy never ending snowstorms.
description:
![Splash Image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alcatrazEscapee/primal-winter/1.19.x/img/splash.png)

_A horrible accident has left the world - the **entire** world - a frozen wasteland. Unending snowstorms rage across the land, from forests, to plains, to jungles, to deserts. The air is thick with fog and wind howls across the landscape. Will you be able to survive in this primordial winter?_

### Features

This mod will turn your entire world into a frozen wasteland. It adds several new blocks, and has many client side aesthetic tweaks to immerse yourself in the winter wonderland you now inhabit.

![A Savanna Biome](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alcatrazEscapee/primal-winter/1.19.x/img/savanna.png)

- A thick white fog obscures your view when you are outside.
- The weather is always snowy and thundering, and there's more snow including extra particle effects and sounds.
- Most surface blocks are replaced with snowy variants. These can be mined to obtain their vanilla counterparts.
- Plants are frozen, and don't grow naturally
- Polar bears and strays now spawn everywhere.
- Ice spikes, icebergs, snow blocks, packed ice, and powder snow all appear sporadically in all biomes.
- Snow and ice placement has been improved and now layers more intuitively and can creep into caves and under overhangs such as trees during world generation.
- Works automatically with any other mods which add new biomes, forcefully converting them to winter versions.
- Villages are all abandoned and devoid of life

![A Savanna Biome](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alcatrazEscapee/primal-winter/1.19.x/img/jungle.png)

### Credit

Thanks to EERussianGuy for making all the wood logs and leaf textures. Thanks to various people in the TerraFirmaCraft discord for their feedback and ideas. 

Hope you enjoy, and stay warm!

~ AlcatrazEscapee

name: Primal Winter Reimagined
summary: A reimagined take on Primal Winter that locks the world in a brutal, atmospheric blizzard with a configurable start day and enhanced snow, fog, and ambience.
description:
> Originally created by AlcatrazEscapee – this is a fan-made, unofficial reimagining of the Primal Winter concept for modern Minecraft, with full credit for the original idea and inspiration going to them.

Support the original: Primal Winter

## ❄ What Is Primal Winter: Reimagined?
Primal Winter: Reimagined turns your world into a bleak, frozen wasteland where survival is less about beating mobs and more about enduring the endless cold – but with a twist: the true winter doesn’t fully begin until a configurable in-game day, giving you a short window to prepare before the blizzard era begins.

This fork keeps the core fantasy of “eternal winter” and pushes it further with:

- Configurable snowstorm start day (default: Day 5)
- Tuned snow density to stay atmospheric without crashing your client
- Integrated Forge config (primalwinter-common.toml) for easy tweaking
- Extra snow, wind ambience, and fog that ramp up once winter truly starts
- One of the core mods to the Everlasting Winter Modpack
🌨 Key Features
 

### Delayed Winter Start

- Use the early days to gather resources and establish a foothold.
- After the configured snowStartDay, the world locks into an endless blizzard: heavy snow, frozen landscapes, and a constant sense of encroaching cold.
- Eternal Snowstorms (Post–Start Day)

- Once winter “starts,” the overworld is locked in permanent snowy weather.
- Snowfall becomes a constant presence, with enhanced visuals and ambience.
- Enhanced Snow & Fog Rendering
- Custom snow density that fills the sky without overwhelming performance.
- Fog colors and density tuned for a bleak, overcast atmosphere.
- Configurable Everything (Forge Config)

**In config/primalwinter-common.toml you can tweak things like:**

- snowStartDay – when the true winter begins.
- snowDensity – how intense the snowfall looks.
- fogDensity, fogColorDay, fogColorNight.
- Toggles for weather/sky render changes, snow sounds, wind ambience, and more.
- Extra Snow Accumulation (After Winter Starts)
- Snow gradually stacks and spreads once the eternal storm is active.
- World feels like it’s being buried over time, not just dusted.

## ⚙ Configuration

After launching the game once with the mod installed, look for:

config/primalwinter-common.toml

Key options include (names may be slightly simplified in the file):
snowStartDay – in-game day at which permanent winter storms and full effects begin.
enableSnowAccumulationDuringWorldgen / enableSnowAccumulationDuringWeather.
snowDensity, fogDensity.
windSounds, snowSounds.
weatherRenderChanges, skyRenderChanges.
You can tune the experience from “subtle cold shift” to “white-out apocalypse”.

## 🧭 Gameplay Notes
 

The terrain is still generated in a wintry state (frozen world, cold biomes), because that’s baked into how Primal Winter reshapes the overworld.
The true storm – constant snow, extra accumulation, heavier ambience – is what’s delayed until snowStartDay.
This works especially well in hardcore/survival worlds where you want:
A brief grace period to gear up.
Then a permanent, escalating survival challenge once the storm hits.

## 🔧 Requirements & Compatibility
 
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Loader: Forge
Designed to be used in the Everlasting Winter modpack
(If you’re using heavy worldgen or weather mods, test first to make sure their changes play nicely with the eternal winter behavior.)

## 📜 Credits & Permissions
 

Original concept & implementation: AlcatrazEscapee – author of the original Primal Winter.
This project: A fan-made, reimagined fork for modern Forge versions with additional configuration and timing controls.

> Please support the original mod and its author – this reimagining exists purely out of admiration for the idea of a world swallowed by winter.

name: Quests & Teams Fixes
summary: A utility mod designed to fix some issues in FTB Quests and FTB Teams, including quests soft locking in bigger modpacks.
description:
# Quests & Teams Fixes

A utility mod designed to fix some issues in FTB Quests and FTB Teams, including quests soft locking in bigger modpacks. Supports both **Forge** and **Fabric**.

## What does this mod fix exactly?

When using the "Flexible" progression mode in FTB Quests, quests can become soft-locked when all tasks are completed before the quest's dependencies are unlocked, displaying the quest being completed at 100% but having a gray checkmark.

## Fixes

- If unlocking a quest checks that a dependent quest already has 100% of its tasks completed, the mod forces the dependent to complete instantly, preventing the soft lock from ever happening.
- For players who are already stuck with gray checkmarks before installing this mod, the fix is applied retroactively on player join.
- This also disables the /ftbquests command, as well as the sidebar button and party creation by 3rd party APIs and mods, for modpacks that use another provider for teams (like OPAC)

name: RS Integration
summary: Recursive crafting, remote machine access, and storage utilities for Refined Storage and Beyond Dimensions, with optional cross-mod integrations.
description:
**Choose a recipe. Preview the plan. Let your machines do the work.**

RS Integration (RSI) adds recursive crafting, remote machine access, and storage tools for **Refined Storage** and **Beyond Dimensions**.

[中文介绍](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/README_zh.md) · [User guide](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/docs/guide/README.md)

## What you can do

- **Craft across mods:** start from JEI/EMI, inspect the recipe tree and missing materials, choose alternatives, and run supported machines. Select inventory, the current storage network, and Sophisticated Backpacks as material sources.
- **Manage machines remotely:** bind machines, open compatible GUIs, and share repeated work across multiple machines. Press `P` for plans, progress, and machine management.
- **Expand your storage:** browse items and fluids in one mixed terminal, or store items, fluids, and magic resources in a Myriad Realms Guixu Disk for RS.
- **Use stored items:** Resonance Disks provide supported passive effects and resource access; resonant containers connect to native Botania and Ars Nouveau systems.
- **Reduce routine work:** transfer container contents with `F`, order food, replenish trades and reforging materials, and use FTB Quests and Sophisticated Backpack integrations.
- **Make it yours:** search plans and machines, use pinyin-aware search, switch UI themes, and edit settings in game.

## Requirements

**Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge 47+ · JEI on the client.** Install the same RSI version on the client and server. EMI support also requires JEI.

Refined Storage 1.12+ and Beyond Dimensions are optional. Ordinary crafting-table recipes work recursively from inventory alone. RS and BD remain separate networks; their balances are never combined automatically.

## Quick start

1. Connect an RS or BD network, or begin with inventory-only crafting.
2. For machine recipes, hold a compatible network linker or terminal and use `Alt` + right-click to bind a machine, or press `;` nearby to scan.
3. Open a recipe in JEI/EMI and click the RSI craft action.
4. Review the plan, choose material sources, recipes, quantity, and output destination, then confirm.
5. Press `P` to follow progress. Cancel in the screen or with `/rsi cancel`.

## Integrations and help

Supported integrations include Botania, Ars Nouveau, Goety, Malum, Embers/Aetherworks, Farmer's Delight and addons, Apotheosis, Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks, and more. Each module loads only with its target mod. Support is recipe-specific; native machine requirements and some manual ritual steps still apply.

- [Full compatibility table](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/docs/guide/README.md#compatibility)
- [Controls, configuration, and recovery commands](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/docs/guide/README.md#controls)
- [中文使用指南](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/docs/guide/README_zh.md)
- [Developer API](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/docs/api/README.md) · [Source code](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration)

## License

Proprietary. Official unmodified releases may be used in modpacks under the [project license](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/rs_integration/blob/master/LICENSE).

name: Re-FTBQLocalizationKeys
summary: A FTB Quests: Localization keys fork, this mod are the basis for simple and easy translations of any modpack quest.
description:
# Re-FTBQLocalizationKeys (Re-FTBQKeys)
This is Fork of FTB Quests: Localization keys, a mod that extracts localization keys from FTB Quests task files and automatically generates language files.

### How to use ?
- Install FTB Quests and KubeJS
- Run your modpack with **fully written quests**
- Write in chat: `/ftbqkey <language code>` (/ftbqkey zh_cn). Language code affects only file name.
- All files will be in the folder `<gamedir>/ftbqkeys/`
- Move the generated files to the appropriate folders (`kubejs/assets/kubejs/lang` and `config/ftbquests/quests`).
- After generating the language you can delete this mod.

### Precautions
- **1.0.0-1.16.5 requires Java 16+**
- If you want to add new quests to the already generated keys, don't do it. All subsequent quests and their localization keys will have to be written manually. This mod should only be used when you have finished writing all the text for your quests.
- It is better to add images after generating localization.
- Images do not perform well in the center of the text.
- If a "Format error" error appears at the top of the text, rewrite the text and try not to use any symbols.
- Task backups are generated in the `ftbqkeys` folder.


### This mod code reference/use:
- [Horeak/ftb-quest-lang-generator (FTB Quests: Localization keys)](https://github.com/Horeak/ftb-quest-lang-generator) (Forge 1.18+) (CC-BY-4.0)
- [criscky/ftb-quest-lang-generator](https://github.com/criscky/ftb-quest-lang-generator) (Forge 1.16.5) (CC-BY-4.0)
- [DM-Fabric-Ports/ftb-quest-lang-generator (FTB Quests: Localization Keys Refabricated)](https://github.com/DM-Fabric-Ports/ftb-quest-lang-generator) (Fabric 1.18+) (CC-BY-4.0)

_**Don't report Re-FTBQKey's any issues to the official FTB Quests: Localization keys Github / CurseForge.**_

name: Refined Storage

description:
![Refined Storage logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KDvYkUg3/images/c63bd35a00d6aa88b1b4b1404f13869c671f225f.png)

## Refined Storage is a mass storage mod for Minecraft that offers the player a network-based storage system, allowing them to store items and fluids on a massively expandable device network.

Items and fluids can be stored in one of the many storage capabilities that the mod offers. Any storage devices connected to the same network are accessible to the player through one simple Grid interface, allowing the player to access the inventories of many devices through a single unified GUI.

This mod not only adds storage solutions, but also devices that can be used to manipulate items and blocks in the world and from within the system, such as importers, exporters, constructors, destructors, and more! There are also devices in this mod that allow the player to setup auto-crafting, allowing the crafting of complex recipes in a few simple clicks.

name: Refined Storage (Fixes) Mixin
summary: Performance and bug fixes for Refined Storage. By MCT.
description:
Official MCT Discord Server [Here](https://discord.com/invite/ujY2mV9).

Assets are protected under the terms in the [LICENSE\_ASSETS](https://github.com/tgstyle/MCT-RS-Mixin/blob/1.20.1-1.0-Release/LICENSE_ASSETS.txt)

## Refined Storage (Fixes) Mixin

Major performance fixes for Refined Storage in 1.20.1 & 1.12.2

Refined Storage Mixin is a performance-focused addon for Refined Storage that reduces server lag in large networks.



- Load rescan – rescans after controller load so cables like EnderIO conduits get detected.
- Conduit placement fix – rescans after placing EnderIO conduits, since an immediate rescan is too early.
- EnderIO RS fix – stops warnings and restores compatibility with EnderIO's RS conduits.
- EnderIO conduit typed backup – prevents EnderIO conduit data from being lost on world reload.
- EnderIO node unify – fixes EnderIO conduits being tracked as two objects after reload.
- RebornStorage crafter fix – fixes multiblock crafter GUI delays, validation, and error messages.
- Damageable input reuse – lets autocrafting reuse damaged tools instead of always crafting new ones.
- Crafting crash guard – stops a broken autocrafting task from crashing the server.
- Grid resync – fixes open grids showing stale or missing item lists.
- Safe data saving – fixes disks wiping to 0/0 after a server restart.
- Skip unloaded – prevents rare deadlocks from touching unloaded chunks.
- Wireless dimension lock – stops wireless items/transmitters working across dimensions from their linked network.
- Throttle – runs full network updates every N ticks instead of every tick.
Bypass fast nodes – lets busy nodes (importers, crafters, etc.) update every tick instead of throttled.
- Dynamic node sleep – lets bypassed nodes idle down when they have no work.
- Dynamic crafting bypass – lets the crafting manager update every tick only while jobs are active.
- Lazy energy – recalculates network energy usage only when the graph changes.
- Hashset optimize – uses plain HashMap/HashSet instead of concurrent versions in single-threaded contexts.
- Connected node tick optimize – skips ticking nodes that aren't connected to a network.
- Storage cache debounce – rebuilds the item/fluid list once instead of once per storage block reconnecting.
- Crafting rebuild debounce – rescans autocrafting patterns once instead of once per crafter reconnecting.
- Graph rescan coalesce – merges multiple rescans triggered at once into a single rescan.
- Tracked insert index – speeds up matching returned items to the right crafting step.

![band-aid rafined storage](https://i.postimg.cc/J0j4XP4H/rsmixin.png)



Before RS Mixin was applied
![screenshot 1](https://i.postimg.cc/FR1L0g0T/Screenshot-2026-01-16-023005.png)

After RS Mixin was applied
![screenshot 2](https://i.postimg.cc/hv1cjNhr/image2.png)

Open up your wireless grid and add the insert or export or block picker upgrade in the slot on the right.

summary: Add functionality to trigger Ars Nouveau magic using SlashBlade.
description:
**SlashNouveau** is an integration addon for **SlashBlade** and **Ars Nouveau**.

**This mod requires** **[CastLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/castlib), [ArsCurios](https://modrinth.com/mod/arscurios)**

 

### **Highlights**

*   **Ars Nouveau** spells can be triggered by **SlashBlade projectiles**.
*   Spells activated via **SlashNouveau** consume **SlashBlade's ProudSoul** instead of **Ars Nouveau's mana**.
*   **SlashBlade's ProudSoul** regenerates up to a certain limit using **Ars Nouveau's mana**.  
  _⚠️This limit is determined by the **Refine** value of the **SlashBlade.**_
*   Uses **Ars Nouveau's SpellBook** for activation, allowing seamless casting of up to **10 different spells**.
*   **Quick selection** of the **SpellBook** is supported even in **dedicated slots**.
*   For **safety reasons**, spells do **not activate during melee attacks**.

### **How to Use**

1.  Prepare a **SlashBlade** that can fire **projectiles**.
2.  Create a **spell** using **Ars Nouveau's SpellBook**.
3.  Place the **SpellBook** into the dedicated **Curios slot**.
4.  Use the **quick select shortcut key** to choose a **spell** from the **SpellBook**.
5.  When the **SlashBlade's projectile** hits an **entity**, the **spell** will be **activated**.

 

### **Note**

*   Make sure to place the **SpellBook** in the dedicated **Curios slot**.
*   To increase the **maximum limit** of **natural ProudSoul regeneration**, you need to raise the **Refine value** of the **SlashBlade**.
*   **Spells** do **not activate** on **blocks** when using **SlashNouveau**.

### **Config**

*   `ProudSoulConsume (Default: 30)`  
         **Mana cost** when casting magic with **SlashBlade's projectile**.
*   `ProudSoulLimitByRefine (Default: 200)`  
         **Maximum value** for **natural ProudSoul recovery** = **Refine × this value**
*   `SpellBookSlots`  
         Slots for the **SpellBook**. (**Do not edit**)

name: Sophisticated JEI Index
summary: JEI recipe transfer integration for Sophisticated Backpack
description:
# Sophisticated JEI Index

Adds a JEI Index Upgrade for Sophisticated Backpacks. When installed, JEI recipe transfer can pull ingredients from equipped backpacks that have this upgrade enabled (in selection order), in addition to the player inventory.

## Features

*   ✅ Compatible with JEI native recipe transfer scenarios
*   ✅ Uses enabled backpacks in the selection order as extra ingredient sources
*   ✅ Also supports the crafting terminals of the following mods (priority: network → player inventory → enabled backpacks in order): AE2, Refined Storage, Tom's Storage, Beyond Dimensions
*   ✅ Supports shift-click max transfer and JEI complete-set semantics
*   ✅ Compatible with EMI recipe fill and recipe tree quick-craft (requires EMI on the server for multiplayer)

## Installation

1.  Put this mod jar into the `mods` folder
2.  Ensure required dependencies are installed
3.  Start the game

## Usage

1.  Equip a Sophisticated Backpack in any slot supported by Sophisticated Backpacks (armor/offhand/main or compat slots)
2.  Put a JEI Index Upgrade into that backpack
3.  Open any crafting container that supports JEI recipe transfer
4.  Click the `+` button in JEI to transfer ingredients

## Notes

*   JEI recipe transfer is a client action that sends a request to the server. For full functionality in multiplayer, JEI must be present on the server as well.
*   EMI recipe fill is a client action that sends a request to the server. For full functionality in multiplayer, EMI must be present on the server as well.
*   The backpack selection order follows Sophisticated Backpacks' B-key logic, but only backpacks with this upgrade enabled are considered.
*   Config option: `maxEnabledBackpacksScanned` (common config). Limits how many enabled backpacks are scanned per player. 0 means unlimited.
*   Nested backpacks (e.g. via Inception Upgrade) are not supported as ingredient sources.

name: Spyglass of Curios
summary:
Now spyglass has a slot of curios, which can be used with a key press. Also,
changing magnification by mouse scrolling and rendering spyglass model is available!
description:
**Spyglass of Curios**
**🔭💍👋🧐**
 --- **Overview**
This mod adds a Curios slot for spyglass. Now, you can friendly use spyglass in the spyglass slot with a key press. You can also adjust the magnification of the spyglass with the mouse scroll. In addition, each spyglass individually saves magnification information, which is displayed in the tooltip.               You can press shift+left-click to switch the render type of spyglass curio on player model, there are three types of renders can be selected. This mod aims to serve as a functional alternative to some mods with inherent magnification features, in order to balance the acquisition of magnification and achieve a more immersive gaming experience. **Configuration**
There are many rich configurations for you to choose from, such as whether to render the spyglass model, setting the maximum and minimum magnification of the spyglass, disabling information display, and so on. It’s worth mentioning that you can enable the OPTIFINE-like cinematic camera in the configuration when the spyglass is activated. **Compatibility**
This mod strives to be as compatible as possible with most mainstream mods, so that it can work normally in most mod packs. Therefore, if you find some compatibility issues with other mods, or someplace where uses awkwardly, please tell me in the issues, and I will try my best to correct it to a satisfactory state~ ---
🌾 Welcome to submit issues or your suggestions! 🌾

Supported Languages
[English (US) | Chinese | French]

name: TFC Astikor Carts
summary: Adding compatibility between Astikor Carts and TerraFirmaCraft
description:
It works similarly to the main [Astikor Carts](https://modrinth.com/mod/astikorcarts-redux) mod, but adds new carts for each wood type present in [TerraFirmaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrafirmacraft). This compatibility mod also adds new mechanics to the plow cart, which can now be used to "mow" large quantities of shrubberies, loose rocks and more. This change also makes it possible to efficiently till soil blocks to farmland where there are a lot of plants.

# General Config

These settings define how carts interact with animals, items, and players. They control what can be carried and how pulling speed is affected by nutrition, thirst, hunger, and cargo weight.

## Animal Cart Settings
- **`maxAnimalSize`**  
  The maximum size (in blocks volume) of an animal that can be loaded into the animal cart. Larger animals above this threshold cannot be carried.  
  *Default: 3.0*

- **`maxPassengerCount`**  
  The maximum number of animals the cart can carry simultaneously.  
  *Default: 2*

- **`canPushIntoPlayers`**  
  If enabled, the animal cart can pick up players by being pushed into them.  
  *Default: true*

- **`canCarryWaterEntities`**  
  If enabled, aquatic creatures (fish, dolphins, whales, etc.) can be picked up by the animal cart.  
  *Default: true*

## Supply Cart Settings
- **`maxItemSize`**  
  The largest item size (inclusive) that can be stored in a supply cart.  
  Allowed values: `TINY`, `VERY_SMALL`, `SMALL`, `NORMAL`, `LARGE`, `VERY_LARGE`, `HUGE`  
  *Default: VERY_LARGE*

## Pulling Behavior
- **`pullingDistanceModifier`**  
  Adjusts the tolerance for how far a cart can be pulled before the connection breaks. Higher values allow greater pulling distance/threshold.  
  *Default: 2.0*

- **`toggleFoodSpeed`**  
  Determines whether the player’s nutrition, thirst, and hunger affect cart pulling speed.  
  - When enabled, pulling speed is scaled by the player’s average nutrition × thirst × hunger.  
  - The formula produces a **health factor** that modifies speed between 25% (minimum) and 100% (maximum).  
  - Example: A well-fed, hydrated player pulls carts faster; a starving, thirsty player pulls slower.  
  *Default: true*

# Cart Inventory Config

These settings control how carts behave in terms of **cargo weight limits** and **inventory size**. They let you fine‑tune the balance between realism and convenience.

## Weight Thresholds

### How Weight Thresholds Interact
The logic:
- **Exhausted Threshold**: If cargo weight exceeds this value, the player gains the *Exhausted* effect.  
- **Overburdened Threshold**: If cargo weight exceeds this higher value, the player gains the *Overburdened* effect.  
- **Pinned Threshold**: If cargo weight exceeds this maximum, the player becomes *Pinned* and immobilized.  

The thresholds act as progressive stages of fatigue based on the estimated cargo mass.

- **`exhaustedThreshold`**  
  The mass (in kilograms) at which a player pulling a cart becomes *exhausted*. At this point, movement slows down significantly.  
  *Default: 400 kg*

- **`overburdenedThreshold`**  
  The mass at which the player becomes *overburdened*. Movement is heavily restricted, but not yet immobilized.  
  *Default: 1000 kg*

- **`pinnedThreshold`**  
  The mass at which the player becomes *pinned* and unable to move at all.  
  *Default: 2000 kg*

> *Example:* A VERY_HEAVY HUGE item might weigh ~280 kg. With a pinned threshold of 800 kg, carrying three such items would immobilize the cart puller.

## Inventory Sizes
- **Hand Cart Inventory**  
  - Rows: `handCartInventoryHeight` (Default: 2)  
  - Columns: `handCartInventoryWidth` (Default: 5)  
  -> This defines a 2×5 grid (10 slots) for the hand cart.

- **Supply Cart Inventory**  
  - Rows: `supplyCartInventoryHeight` (Default: 5)  
  - Columns: `supplyCartInventoryWidth` (Default: 9)  
  -> This defines a 5×9 grid (45 slots) for the supply cart.

## As of **version 1.2**

_Relevant mostly for mod and modpack makers:_

- Automatic item and entity registration of **any** wood types from enum classes that implements TFC's [RegistryWood](<https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/net/dries007/tfc/util/registry/RegistryWood.java>) interface! (_e.g.: supports mods like [ArborFirmaCraft](<https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/arborfirmacraft>)_)
- You **only** need to supply the relevant datapack files (_recipes, tags, tfc data, etc._) and assets (_textures, item models, lang, etc._)!

This addon further expands upon the features provided by Caelum, and adds the following:

- Lunar eclipses (aka blood moons)
- Solar eclipses
- Planets
- Rainbows after it has rained
- Increased surface monster presence during blood moons, and even higher if a supermoon is actual simultaneously

There's no guarantee that the mod will work with any *random* mod that *also* makes changes to e.g. the moon cycle and/or location of either the sun and/or the moon on the sky. Additionally disable TFC's `Calendar Sensitive Moon Phases` configuration, as otherwise the moon phases will be out of place.

*This naturally requires both mods in order to work.*

name: TFC Improved Badlands
summary: Changes how badlands appear in TFC in dry and humid areas
description:
This is an addon for [TerraFirmaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrafirmacraft), that simply changes how badland biomes look and generate in the world. Badland biomes generate like regular in dryer areas, whilst their terrains have changed to be more "normal" towards more humid areas. The more humid terrains assigned to badlands will not have sand or sandstone anymore, and instead have grass, dirt and rocks. The terrain slowly changes into the other, where the "middle point" (50% terrain weight of each other) is at 115 rainfall. When the area is dry enough, sand dunes will start to generate. The threshold values for when the biome terrain should change into dunes or regular badlands are configurable.

Adding my other TFC addon [TFC Weather](https://modrinth.com/mod/tfc-weather) allows for more gradual sand slopes, as that mod adds layered sand blocks. This works very well with the sand dunes at lower rainfall levels. Furthermore, the dunes and layered sand fits very well with [TFC Barrens](https://modrinth.com/mod/tfc-barrens), as it completely changes the world to one big desert.

name: TFC Regrowing Forests
summary: Makes the forests in the world of TerraFirmaCraft slowly spread
description:
This mod makes the forests in TerraFirmaCraft regenerate or spread over time. Trees only spread during fall, as this is when they typically drop their seed-bearing fruits, as such new trees will be ready for the next spring. Which trees that can spread or regenerate is configurable using a data pack, as well is how fast and how far they can spread their seeds.

Supports [ArborFirmaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/arborfirmacraft-(afc)) out-of-the-box.

# Forest Regrowth Recipes

Regrowth Recipes define how plants, bushes, and trees naturally spread and regenerate in the world. Instead of a static world wherin no trees or vegetation spread, each recipe specifies the conditions under which a sapling (_or otherwise specified block_) can appear, making forests, vegetation and the world feel more alive, interactive and responsive to and with their surroundings.

The mod adds spreading mechanics to TFC leaves, fruit tree leaves and fruit bushes.

## Features

*   Dynamic forest growth  
    Leaves or bushes can spread into new saplings over time, simulating natural regrowth.
    
*   Environment-aware spawning  
    Growth can be restricted by rock types, altitude ranges, and light levels.
    
*   Climate sensitivity  
    Recipes can enforce temperature and rainfall thresholds, including average values and variance.
    
*   Groundwater and hydration checks  
    Plants only spread in viable soil conditions.
    
*   Forest type integration  
    Recipes can be tied to specific forest types and subtypes.
    
*   Seasonal control  
    Regrowth can be limited to specific months of the year.
    
*   Chance and spread distance  
    Configurable probability and radius determine how often and how far saplings appear.
    

## Minimum Viable Recipe

Here's the smallest valid recipe definition, showing only the required fields:

```
{
  "type": "tfcrf:regrowth",
  "leaves": [
    "<block ingredient>"
  ],
  "sapling": "<block state>"
}
```

This ensures the recipe is functional. By default, chance, spread distance, environment, climate, groundwater, forest, and season all allow regrowth without restrictions. You only need to add extra fields when you want to constrain growth to specific conditions.

## Example Recipe

Below is a more detailed recipe for oak trees, showing how you can constrain regrowth to specific conditions. This uses already established environmental conditions required for oak trees to generate in TFC:

```
{
  "type": "tfcrf:regrowth",
  "leaves": [
    "tfc:wood/leaves/oak"
  ],
  "sapling": "tfc:wood/sapling/oak",
  "chance": 4572,
  "spread_distance": 19,
  "rocks": [],
  "min_y": 60,
  "max_y": 85,
  "min_light": 11,
  "max_light": 15,
  "min_average_temperature": -5.8,
  "max_average_temperature": 8.6,
  "min_rainfall_variance": -0.3,
  "max_rainfall_variance": 0.45,
  "min_groundwater": 210,
  "max_groundwater": 380,
  "forest_types": [],
  "forest_sub_types": [],
  "months": [
    "january",
    "february",
    "march",
    "april",
    "may",
    "june",
    "july",
    "august",
    "september",
    "october",
    "november",
    "december"
  ]
}
```

## Possible Recipe Objects

A regrowth recipe can include the following objects. Only `leaves` and `sapling` are strictly required; all others are optional and default to permissive values if omitted.

### Base Data

*   **leaves**: One or more leaf blocks that can spread into saplings.
*   **sapling**: The block state of the sapling that will be placed when conditions are met.
*   **chance**: Probability factor for regrowth. Larger numbers mean rarer events. Default: `3000.0`.
*   **spread\_distance**: Maximum horizontal distance a new sapling can appear from the source leaves. Default: `18.0`.

### Environment Data

*   **rocks**: List of allowed rock types. Use lowercase names (`"andesite"`, `"gabbro"`, `"gneiss"`, etc.). Empty list means no restriction.
*   **min\_y**: Minimum altitude (Y-level). Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_y**: Maximum altitude (Y-level). Default: unrestricted.
*   **min\_light**: Minimum light level. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_light**: Maximum light level. Default: unrestricted.

### Climate Data

*   **min\_temperature**: Minimum current temperature. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_temperature**: Maximum current temperature. Default: unrestricted.
*   **min\_average\_temperature**: Minimum average temperature. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_average\_temperature**: Maximum average temperature. Default: unrestricted.
*   **min\_rainfall**: Minimum current rainfall. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_rainfall**: Maximum current rainfall. Default: unrestricted.
*   **min\_average\_rainfall**: Minimum average rainfall. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_average\_rainfall**: Maximum average rainfall. Default: unrestricted.
*   **min\_rainfall\_variance**: Minimum rainfall variance tolerated. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_rainfall\_variance**: Maximum rainfall variance tolerated. Default: unrestricted.

### Groundwater Data

*   **min\_groundwater**: Minimum groundwater level required. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_groundwater**: Maximum groundwater level allowed. Default: unrestricted.
*   **min\_hydration**: Minimum soil hydration required. Default: unrestricted.
*   **max\_hydration**: Maximum soil hydration allowed. Default: unrestricted.

### Forest Data

*   **forest\_types**: Restrict regrowth to specific forest types. Empty list means no restriction. See [ForestType](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/net/dries007/tfc/world/chunkdata/ForestType.java#L23-L51) for the full list.
*   **forest\_sub\_types**: Restrict regrowth to specific forest subtypes. Empty list means no restriction. See [ForestSubType](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/net/dries007/tfc/world/chunkdata/ForestType.java#L214-L222) for the full list.

### Season Data

*   **months**: List of months when regrowth can occur. Use lowercase names (`"january"`, `"february"`, etc.). Empty list means no restriction. See [Month](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/net/dries007/tfc/util/calendar/Month.java#L21-L32) for the full list.

***

## Summary

*   At minimum, a recipe needs **leaves** and **sapling**.
*   All other fields let you constrain regrowth by environment, climate, groundwater, forest type, or season.
*   Defaults are permissive (no restrictions, infinite ranges), so you only add fields when you want to limit regrowth.

name: TFC Volcanoes
summary: Enhancing magmatic processes and surface‑level geothermal flux!
description:
This addon for [TerraFirmaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrafirmacraft) adds new mechanics to volcanoes, such as eruptions, earthquakes, tremors, pyroclastic bombs, new methods to regenerate minerals, and reintroduces the well-known mineral deposits, that could deposit near pools of spring water and lava, from TerraFirmaCraft versions 1.7.10 and prior to TFC 1.20.1 and 1.21.1!

For the flowing fluids, as seen in some images, I recommend adding the [Flowing Fluids](https://modrinth.com/mod/flowing-fluids) mod (and configuring it yourself).

There are many new types of minerals that can spawn around both lava and hot springs, examples being sulphur, ammonium chloride, salt, saltpeter and many more. Some of the new minerals can also be pulverized into usable fertilizers! This addon also makes lava behave differently depending on the local rock type (configurable); in certain rock types lava will spread very slow over and short distance, while much faster and farther if in the right conditions.

Besides, throwing "moist" items into lava can make for some funny reactions!

description:
Integration mod for TerraFirmaCraft and Cobblemon for Forge 1.20.1. Have you ever wished Cobblemon was more realistic? If so, this is the mod for you! Hunt Pokemon with spears, forage for tumblestones and apricorns to create Pokeballs, and infuse pottery with life to craft your first Pokemon. With this integration mod, you now have the ability to find and collect Pokemon in a completely new, realistic world. ## Features include: - 250 Pokémon spawns, each with new loot tables - Crafting recipes for Pokéballs, PC, Healing Machine, evolution items, and more - Natural medicines found in the wild and through cooking - Craftable Golett with the new Blank Orb item - Custom forms for Steelix and Scizor based around Wrought Iron and Black/Blue/Red Steel - Custom spawn presets for different biomes, climates, and seasons - Saltwater and freshwater Pokémon - Assets from 1.21, including Corphish, Sunflora, Spheal, Clauncher, and Corsola YouTube Trailer: [https://youtu.be/c2Q1lYUa7PI?si=UwZGxyz3ns530vDa](https://youtu.be/c2Q1lYUa7PI?si=UwZGxyz3ns530vDa)

Report issues here:[https://github.com/kingtrapinch/tfcobblemon/issues](https://github.com/kingtrapinch/tfcobblemon/issues) Join the discord: [https://discord.com/channels/934267676354834442/1359192934251237386](https://discord.com/channels/934267676354834442/1359192934251237386)  Clay Golett made with a Fired Vessel and Life Orb: ![Picture of raw golett](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4877e81a4e018f7d7390f5711ac1c6c213c5f10a_0.webp) ## Advanced Features:
Added Items ![Added Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbd27d1e702cf91a4f37b75b29e3f17a7aeb9dff.png) - Blank Orb - Blank Orb (charging) - Raw Protector (smelt yellow-white to get Protector item) - Suspicious vessel (for each color of vessel)
Advanced Pokéball metal tiers: ![pokeball metal tiers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66743d35ee6712be98e627ee77c3c110e7c410b5.png)
Apricorn locations Apricorns drop from breaking tree leaves. You can get a higher yield by using a tool like a knife or scythe. The apricorn type depends on the tree species, and are grouped by climate.

Apricorn climate map (based on average temp and percipitation, values will overlap in-game)

![average apricorn climates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce82ec9185aeb6ad0c6a04df075d13543659803.png)
Requires Kube.js to work. Needed for water-breathing and custom items to work properly.

name: TerraFirmaCraft
summary: TerraFirmaCraft (TFC) is a total conversion mod that overhauls and reinvents survival mode.
description:
![A screenshot of TFC with a canyon overlooking a river. The sun is setting in the background. Tall oak and other dedicious trees are scattered on the lower areas of the valley.](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/blob/1.21.x/img/splash-1.png?raw=true)

## Survival Mode As It Should've Been


**TerraFirmaCraft (TFC)** is a total conversion mod that overhauls and reinvents survival mode. The goal of the mod is to create a believable, challenging survival experience, in a brand new immersive setting. It completely overhauls Minecraft world generation - from adding continents, to flowing rivers, to mountain ranges, to varied and diverse forests, flora, and fauna. Below is a list of some of the features of this mod:

- The underground has been completely reimagined, with layers of different types of rock, and massive sparse ore deposits of several different types.
- A fully fledged technology tree, from pottery and pit kilns, to charcoal production, producing iron with a bloomery, steel making and more.
- Seasons, weather, and a realistic climate and calendar model cause the player to need to stockpile food for winter to survive.
- The world is alive, with many different plants, wild crops, wild fruits, animals - both passive and predators - to find
- The player must manage their food's expiration, nutrition, and thirst using our detailed food and cooking mechanics.
 

In order to understand all of these new features, TerraFirmaCraft comes with a detailed in-game Field Guide, which is available from the moment you spawn in, and will guide you through the art of surviving in this brand-new world.


--- Join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/PRuAKvY) / Check out the [Field Guide](https://terrafirmacraft.github.io/Field-Guide/en_us/) ---
 

![A wide screenshot of TFC showing five different environments side by side: A river running through a desert-like area, a bamboo forest, a swampy forest, a lake surrounded by birch trees, and a snow covered mountain range.](https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/blob/1.21.x/img/splash-2.png?raw=true)

*An example of the different types of environments you might find in TerraFirmaCraft.*

 

**For Servers**: In `server.properties`, You need to change the `level-type` to enable TFC world generation:

- For **1.12**: Set it to `tfc_classic`
- For **1.18**: Set it to `tfc:tng`
- For **1.20 & 1.21**: Set it to `tfc\:overworld`

**For Pack and Addon Developers**: Huge parts of TerraFirmaCraft are customizable using datapacks, and all the formats and data we use are included in our [API Documentation](https://terrafirmacraft.github.io/Documentation/)

---

This mod is based on original work by Robert "Bioxx" Anthony, Amanda "Kittychanley" Halek, and others, and has been made possible by the dedicated work of Dries007, Bunsan, AlcatrazEscapee, EERussianguy, and many others. With original music by Mike "Menoch" Pelaez.

name: TerraFirmaCraft AnvilHelper
summary: Helper mod to show which button to press to make a craft on TFC Anvils.
description:
# TerraFirmaCraft AnvilHelper

Helper mod to show which button to press to make a craft on TFC Anvils.

This mod is client-side only and doesn't require to be on the server to work.

# Why?

I was making compatibility mod, and it was impossible for me to successfully
make a single anvil recipe despite having a YouTube tutorial opened on my other screen.

This mod is more meant as an accessibility tool so players are not locked out of the TFC Anvil system.

name: The Aether
summary: The Aether Team presents the original Aether mod! Maintained and kept up to date for modern versions of Minecraft and fully compatible with multiplayer!
description:
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/The-Aether-Team/The-Aether/1.21.1-develop/docs/assets/banner.webp)

[![Aether Legends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/The-Aether-Team/.github/refs/heads/main/images/legends.png)](https://sparkuniverse.com/get/aether-legends)

☁️ About the Aether ☁️

The Aether Team presents the original Aether mod! Maintained and kept up to date for modern versions of Minecraft and fully compatible with multiplayer! The Aether centers around a dimension high in the sky, filled with **vast skylands** of clouds and **floating islands**. This dimension features its own new survival adventure, based around a basic vanilla-esque **survival progression** that features **new ores**, **mythical mobs**, and **three perilous dungeons** each with their own **powerful loot items**.

☁️ What's in the Mod ☁️

The Aether consists of many new accessible features, most of which are explained in the original forum post for the [Aether Collaboration Mod](https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/minecraft-mods/1275355-1-7-3-aether-collaboration-mod-v1-02-new-mobs). A brief overview of this content includes: * A Hostile Paradise in the sky: the Aether dimension! Just make sure not to fall off of it, or you’ll end up back in the Overworld. * A range of new blocks and items accessible from the dimension itself. * 3 utility blocks: The Altar, Freezer, and Incubator. * 4 material tiers: Skyroot, Holystone, Zanite, and Gravitite, each with their own tools and weapons with unique abilities. * The Book of Lore, complete with an entry for every block and item in the mod. * An accessory system with a unique GUI that lets you utilize the loot you discover. * Mobs both reminiscent of the Overworld and unique to the Aether. * Moas: a flying mob mount with different tiers of differing jump counts. * 3 new structures to conquer: the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Dungeons, each with their own equipment to loot and bosses to defeat. * Eternal Day, only able to be ended once the final dungeon is conquered, then the day cycle can be controlled with a unique utility block: the Sun Altar.
[![Essential](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/The-Aether-Team/.github/refs/heads/main/images/essential.png)](https://essential.gg/x/aether)

☁️ Getting Started ☁️

To get started with the Aether, you must construct a portal with a **Glowstone frame** and light it with a **water bucket** in the middle, this will activate the portal and allow you to step through and enter the dimension. From here you can begin your survival in the Aether’s hostile paradise!

☁️ Conquering Dungeons ☁️

The Aether's world contains three new mysterious dungeons, each with a fearsome boss to defeat... The **Bronze Dungeon** is the home of the Sentries and guarded by the ominous **Slider**, a creature born of pure stone. Look out for hidden tunnels through islands and prepare yourself with the best gear you can craft! The **Silver Dungeon** is the beautiful Valkyrie Temple. Challenge the knights of the Valkyrie Order and, if you prove worthy, fight the **Valkyrie Queen** herself. Utilize every tool and trick you can to best this ancient warrior.  Within the rare **Gold Dungeon** lies the **Sun Spirit**, an eternal being of pure fire and energy. He is the God that rules the very Sun itself and will take some convincing to even pay attention to a being such as yourself. But it is rumored he guards some of the best treasure that exists in the Aether.

☁️ Join the Conversation ☁️

Come join our Discord server to chat with a growing community of over 10,000 members! Have a question for the developers? Need help setting the mod up? Found a bug? We have dedicated support and development channels for the Aether mod! Or maybe you just want to chat about the mod or organise play sessions on our official server? The Aether Discord is the place to be! Our friendly staff and welcoming community will make sure you feel at home with us!

☁️ Support The Aether Team ☁️

Without your support, making the Aether wouldn’t have been possible. Please consider pledging to help fund development! Every pledge goes directly towards development and enables us to continue doing what we love most.

☁️ Contributing to the Project ☁️

Looking to contribute to the Aether mod? The Aether is open source, meaning anyone who is interested is able to contribute code to help out the project! More info about this can be found on our [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/The-Aether-Team/The-Aether/blob/1.19.4-develop/docs/README.md#wrench-contribute-to-the-project). We also accept translations for the project through [Crowdin](https://translate.aether.devaether.com/), allowing the Aether to be accessible to more players! Both our [Translation](https://github.com/The-Aether-Team/The-Aether/blob/1.19.4-develop/docs/README.md#speech_balloon-translations) and [Code Contribution](https://github.com/The-Aether-Team/The-Aether/blob/1.19.4-develop/docs/CREDITS.txt) credits can be found on our GitHub repository.

At the moment this only applies to 1.20.1 players, but I will be backporting the update to 1.19.2 as well in the near future, once the bugs have been ironed out of the main release*


The Aether: Redux is an expansive addon mod for the well-known Aether mod, adding a wide variety of new content ranging from several new biomes to an overhaul to the mod's first dungeon. There are a variety of other new features as well! A whole lot of new mob models have also been implemented, which are all configurable as well, so you can choose between Redux's upgraded versions and the originals if you prefer them. You can also configure Redux's built-in asset overrides resource pack, using the new in-game config system created specifically for this, so you can change the appearance of various parts of the mod to your hearts content! Speaking of configuration, the mod *also* has a *ton* of configuration options, so check those out, as you could very well prefer certain options over others. --- ADDITIONAL CREDITS: Aerod and BrianIsBro - Their Jappafied Aethers resource pack of which several textures in this mod use as a base, along with the style of the pack that this mod uses Emile van Krieken - A few music tracks which are added in this mod 345boneshoss - Their Glacia trapdoor and door textures they gave me for this mod, along with the shapes for the Blightwillow door and trapdoor RazorDevs - Their Roseroot tree shapes they allowed me to use for the Glacia tree shapes unroman - Ukranian translation Parallel113 - Chinese (Simplified) translation IcyCrystal - Concept and texture for the Subzero Crossbow weapon ModdingLegacy - The 'cow' sounds from their Moolands mod, which were used for... *something...* in the mod Builderdog841 - Complete overhaul of the biome balancing, bringing much better generation to the mod Jonathing - Improvements to the mod's Mixin code LlamaLad7 - MixinExtras, which is an embedded library dependency Wurlette - New menu track for the mod's main menu

name: The Unofficial Ice And Fire Modpack
summary: Face down mythical dragons, master ancient spells, and forge a kingdom from frost and flame. The Ice and Fire Modpack blends brutal magic, ferocious beasts, and performance-friendly design for a fantastical survival adventure.
description:
Step into a world where dragons rule the skies, sorcerers craft spells, and every corner hides ancient power. The Ice and Fire Modpack is a thrilling Forge-based Minecraft experience built around the awe-inspiring Ice and Fire mod and its extended ecosystem — with quality-of-life improvements and enhancements tailored to fantasy adventurers, lore seekers, and survivalists.

Whether you want to slay legendary beasts, brew mystical recipes, or build spell-laced kingdoms, this modpack equips you with the tools and thrill to live out your fantasy RPG dreams — all while maintaining solid performance and compatibility.
🧩 Key Features
🐲 Mythical Beasts & Battle Systems

    Ice and Fire: The legendary creature mod with dragons, hydras, trolls, and more!

    Ice and Fire Patcher & Curios Support: Ensures compatibility and wearable trinkets for magical loadouts.

    Gekolib: Backend animation library for smooth, lifelike creature motion.

    Chat Heads: Adds a visual RPG-style chat indicator for multiplayer immersion.

🌾 Farming & Survival

    Farmer's Delight: Deepens cooking and survival crafting with functional kitchen systems and harvest mechanics.

    Essential Mod: Adds easy multiplayer invites, screenshot tools, and cross-device syncing — perfect for sharing epic dragon encounters.

⚙️ Performance & UI Optimization

    Dynamic FPS & ImmediatelyFast: Improves idle FPS and rendering efficiency without sacrificing visuals.

    Memory Leak Fix: Prevents memory bloat in longer sessions — ideal for marathon campaigns.

    FerriteCore: Reduces RAM usage while maintaining mod compatibility.

🧭 Exploration & Utility

    Xaero’s Minimap: Navigate your mythical world with detailed mapping and waypoints.

    Patchouli: Delivers in-game guides and documentation, ideal for modded tutorials and lorebooks.

    Citadel & Curios API: Crucial support libraries for entity management and accessory handling.

name: Thermal And Space
summary: Thermal And Space add Thermal ores to Ad Astra Planets
description:
![Thermal And Space Logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mrthomas20121-Mods/Thermal-And-Space/master/src/main/resources/assets/thermal_and_space/thermal_in_space.png)
# What is Thermal And Space?
Thermal And Space is an Ad Astra and Thermal addon that add Thermal Ores to Ad Astra Planets.
# Where does the ores spawn?
- Oil Shale is found on the Moon, Mars and Venus.
- Apatite is found on the Moon, Mars  and Venus.
- Cinnabar is found on Mercury, Mars, Venus.
- Lead is found on Venus, Glacio and Mars.
- Nickel is found on Mercury and The Moon.
- Niter is found on Mercury, Glacio and The Moon.
- Ruby is found on The Moon, Mars and Venus.
- Sapphire is found on Mercury and Venus.
- Silver is found on The Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus.
- Tin is found on all planets => The Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus, Glacio.

All the ores have higher spawn rate than Thermal's Overwold ores.
# Can i tweak the oregen?

Yes you can, the oregen is done via datapack.

You need to change the placed features at `resources/data/thermal/worldgen/placed_feature/space_orename.json`.

name: Thermal Cultivation
summary: Thermal gets Agrarian!
description:
![Thermal Cultivation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoFH/Version/master/thermal/media/thermal_cultivation.png "Thermal Cultivation")

__Active Development__: Minecraft 1.18.2

__Website: [Team CoFH](https://teamcofh.com)__

__Discord: [Team CoFH Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/uRKrnbH)__

__Changelog: [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoFH/Version/main/thermal/changelog.md)__

---

Thermal gets Agrarian!

For nearly a decade, the Thermal Series mods have been a cornerstone of modded gameplay. They've pioneered gameplay innovations and optimizations used in practically every modern mod in existence. The Forge Energy system was built from Redstone Flux, and many common modded features - side reconfiguration, advanced redstone control, blue/orange input coloring - all started with the Thermal Series.

The Thermal Series is a modular series of mods, allowing players, server owners, and modpack creators to easily choose the aspects which they want and those which they do not, allowing it to fit into a variety of gameplay styles and worlds.

As a set, the mods form a cohesive experience which greatly expands the Minecraft universe in a lore-friendly (but admittedly technological) way.

This module contains "Cultivation" - a collection of farming and food related things to make your world more agrarian and delicious!

The mods are still being updated regularly and the Series is not complete yet! We're working on it and appreciate your patience. Even so, there's a LOT of stuff for both newcomers and veterans. We hope you enjoy the new Thermal Series.

### __Configuration__

- _Client_: `thermal-client.toml` file located in `/config`
- _Server_: `thermal-server.toml` located in the `/saves/WORLD_NAME/serverconfigs` folder.

Copying this file to your `/defaultsconfig` folder will apply those configs to all newly created worlds.

Dedicated servers will have this file in `/world/serverconfigs`

## __Features__

This section describes features available for the version under active development. Older versions may have different features.

WIP - Thanks for your patience.

![Thermal Series](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoFH/Version/master/thermal/media/thermal_series.png "Thermal Series") 

### __The other modules are here:__

- __[Thermal Foundation](https://modrinth.com/mod/thermal-foundation) - Basics and Resources__
- __[Thermal Dynamics - Not Yet Updated to 1.16](https://modrinth.com/mod/thermal-dynamics) - Logistics and Transport__
- __[Thermal Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/thermal-expansion) - Machinery and Industry (The original mod)__
- __[Thermal Innovation](https://modrinth.com/mod/thermal-innovation) - Advanced Power Tools and Gadgets__

name: Thermal Shock
summary: A Sci-Fi Lore-Heavy Winter Dimension Mod with an emphasis on Combat
description:
- **THIS MOD REQUIRES GECKOLIB, INTEGRATED API AND AAA PARTICLES, AND SUPPORTS FOGGYPALEGARDEN.**
- **FOR THE SOUNDTRACK, DOWNLOAD THE MUSIC TRIGGERS ADD-ON, FREE ON PATREON.**

Thermal Shock is a progression and combat focused dimension mod featuring Loqendia, the Endless Garden. A once lush and thriving realm, now cursed with an eternal winter, and infested with the undead.

[![ModDex rating](https://moddex.gg/badges/projects/thermal-shock/rating.svg?style=banner)](https://moddex.gg/mod/thermal-shock)

# NEW Version 08, DARK INJECTION
Very late Halloween update. This one doesn't even have a cool trailer. Talk about a fall from grace :heartbroken:

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/y-mS1zeEDM4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## 🔑 Entering Loqendia
The dimension can be accessed with a Keystone, which you will be prompted to retrieve early on. Using it on a 3x3 obsidian platform will create the Atlas, granting access to Loqendia.

## 🗺️ New Dimension
Loqendia is a vast frozen expanse containing various new flora and fauna. Bright new wood types can be found along with a multitude of stone variants. A large roster of wildlife populate the surface, while hordes of hostiles and old constructs lurk underground.

## 👥 Character Mobs (or NPCs)
Thermal Shock's main standout feature is the unique, wacky personalities you'll encounter in your playthrough. They provide items in exchange for XP and spice, and offer a few pointers as to where to go next. Some might even have a favor or two to ask of you.

## ⛏️ Ores
The main set of Thermal Shock's tools and armor is crafted with Ruby ore, ranking at around diamond tier.
Other ores feature more niche uses, or are not bound to a specific tier of equipment.

## 🌟 Zenith Upgrades
Zenith Smithing Templates are used for unlocking Set Bonuses of Loqendian armor sets, granting the wearer a passive buff if they have a full matching set of Zenith armor equipped.
They can be found on occasion in most structures.

## 🔄 Alternate Ore Generation
Not all worlds will generate the same set of ores. Some worlds will generate Bloodstone over Ruby, some will generate Bismuth over Malachite.
_Alternative ores can be converted into their counterparts and vice versa. All ores are obtainable through structure loot, too._

## 🛠️ Fabricator
A special crafting station which uses an unconventional system. Instead of requiring a specific shape on a grid, Fabricator recipes call for large amounts of materials which are pulled directly from your inventory.
Items crafted with the Fabricator range from specialized armor pieces to heavy firearms.

## 🎼 Soundtrack
Thermal Shock has a massive OST made by yours truly. Most of it is already in the mod as BGM and music discs, but if you want MORE music, each major version comes with a little addon for the Music Triggers mod, adding even more music for certain bosses and events.


_(This mod is still in beta, there will be bugs. If you find any, or have any questions or suggestions regarding the mod and future updates, feel free to leave a comment somewhere on my YouTube; "ThermaDevYT.")_

_(Made With MCreator)_

name: Thermal Vision Goggles
summary: Craftable Thermal, White Hot and Night Vision goggles for tactical PvP and survival. Animated 3D models, rechargeable batteries and optional Curios support.
description:
# Thermal Vision Goggles

**Three craftable vision devices for tactical PvP, survival, and modpacks.** Choose classic thermal imaging, White Hot, or Night Vision. Originally created for a small Battle Royale server with weapon mods such as TaCZ and Superb Warfare.

## New in 5.1: White Hot & Night Vision

| Device | What you see | Center crafting ingredient |
|---|---|---|
| Thermal Goggles | Living targets in a hot palette against a cold blue world | Amethyst Block |
| White Hot Goggles | White living targets against a grayscale world | Quartz Block |
| Night Vision Goggles | Green amplification of existing shadow detail, without heat highlighting | Emerald Block |

These are **three separate items**, not modes cycled by a key. Equip the goggles you want and press **V** to turn them on or off.

### White Hot

![White Hot in-game: white living target against a grayscale world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/n4vOEZ2z/images/5de0b83b2b3ce86ab0a2264be25b9d5579912053.png)

White Hot highlights the actual models of supported living entities. Like the original thermal goggles, it detects targets up to **96 blocks**, limited by entity render distance. Thermal highlighting is designed to respect solid-wall occlusion. Invisible entities, spectators, and armor stands are excluded.

### Night Vision

![Night Vision enabled in-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/n4vOEZ2z/images/51284226414d9d6c94ab155c23f360a091244f0f.png)

![The same scene with Night Vision disabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/n4vOEZ2z/images/f21ae7bfc82445f71616679022f2b99ce7dba046.png)

Night Vision uses a green palette, grain and a vignette to amplify existing shadow detail. It does **not** apply a heat mask or an entity-detection radius. Completely black pixels contain no detail for the effect to recover.

### Models and inventory icons

![White Hot and Night Vision model previews: textured geometry, not an in-game screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/n4vOEZ2z/images/2d9acf9554d9a0aecfe0f65698850619cfe2935e.png)

Both new devices have their own 3D models, active/inactive textures, and visor raise/lower animations visible to other players. White Hot uses pale textured lenses; Night Vision uses a wide green visor and a dark helmet-style housing.

![Inventory icons: original Thermal, White Hot and Night Vision](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/n4vOEZ2z/images/786f74b84168c40e740430fb4b00b1fb68eb1619.png)

The original thermal device remains available, including its cold-world effect, luminous-block glows, sounds, and charge HUD. Luminous-block glows are specific to the original thermal mode.

## Crafting

All three goggles use this **shaped** recipe:

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| Redstone Block | Empty | Redstone Block |
| Tinted Glass | Variant block | Tinted Glass |
| Leather | Leather | Leather |

Use an **Amethyst Block** for Thermal Goggles, a **Quartz Block** for White Hot Goggles, or an **Emerald Block** for Night Vision Goggles.

**Thermal Battery — shapeless:** 1 Redstone Dust + 1 Iron Ingot.

## How to use and recharge

1. Craft your preferred device, or obtain it in Creative mode.
2. Without Curios, equip it in the **helmet slot**. With Curios, use the functional **Head accessory slot** alongside your regular helmet. Cosmetic slots do not activate vision.
3. Press **V** to toggle the equipped device. The binding can be changed in Minecraft's Controls settings. The HUD identifies the active vision mode and remaining charge.
4. A full charge lasts **60 seconds of active use**. Power is consumed only while enabled.
5. Hold a **Thermal Battery** and right-click while wearing the goggles to fully recharge them. One battery is consumed in Survival. Running out of charge switches the effect off; the device can be recharged.

The same battery works with **all three devices**.

## Versions and installation

| Minecraft | Loader | Build |
|---|---|---|
| 1.20.1 | Forge 47.x | **5.1**, including White Hot and Night Vision |
| 1.21.1 | Forge | **4.0.0-1.21.1 Beta**, separate preview without the new 5.1 devices |

For 1.20.1, use Java 17. The 5.1 build is compiled against Forge 47.4.10.

Install **5.1 on both client and server**. The network protocol changed from 5.0; update everyone together. TaCZ and Superb Warfare are not required dependencies. Fabric and NeoForge builds are not currently published.

[Curios API](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) is **optional**. For 1.20.1 / Forge, use **5.14.1 or later in the 5.x series**.

## Compatibility and support

External shader packs, translucent-block behavior, custom living renderers, and the new variants with Curios at runtime have not been comprehensively verified. Compatibility can vary with your modpack.

[Report a bug](https://github.com/Crayfish3r/thermal_vision_1.20.1_forge/issues) · [Source code](https://github.com/Crayfish3r/thermal_vision_1.20.1_forge) · [Discord community](https://discord.com/invite/JeeVgXuv9S)

Please include your Minecraft, Forge and mod versions, rendering mods or shader pack, and screenshots/logs when reporting a problem.

name: Tough As Nails: A Curios Expansion
summary: Ever thought Tough as Nails needed a few baubles?
description:
# **Tough As Nails: A Curios Expansion**
Tough As Nails: A Curios Expansion is a addon for [Tough as Nails](https://modrinth.com/mod/tough-as-nails) by [Adubbz](https://modrinth.com/user/Adubbz) that adds several baubles to the game via the [Curios API](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) by [TheIllusiveC4](https://modrinth.com/user/TheIllusiveC4) along with a direct progression structure to counteract the temperatures.

## Requirements
![Available for Forge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5ab99e9e374660b90fc09e145467961de3ca075.png)
![Requires Tough as Nails](https://i.imgur.com/H7tvggx.png) ![Requires Curios API](https://i.imgur.com/ToDdyvG.png)

## Description
This mod aims to make it so temperature serves it's purpose in the early game, becomes easier in the mid game - and stops being a nusisance in the late game.

Ever found temperature really fun and interesting for the first few hours of your playthrough? Thought that there should be some kind of progression outside of just Thermal Tuning? Say hello to "Thermal Insulation" a new type of Curios inventory that allows you to craft and equip Thermal Pads that have different effects; there's one to counteract burning to death and one to counteract freezing to death... and if you're up for the challenge a universal one that counteracts burning/freezing to both elements; you're going to have to brew some new Firoze Liquid to make it though ahost a bunch of other rare ingredients.

## Features
### 1. New Insulation Curios Baubles slot
```
You can place three types of Insulation in the new slot. 
Heating, Cooling & Universal; all with their own unique crafting recipes.
```
### 2. New self-regulation redstone circuits 
```
These new circuits are used in order to craft insulation and provide a unique recipe for the insulation items.
```
### 3. Seemless integration and advancement progression
```
Adds additional gameplay and progression to Tough as Nails. 
Aswell as enhancing your curios slots; there is an advancement tree to unlock to complete your playthrough!
```

## Images

![Easily slot in new insulation!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46f3eb0473056554ac59a17265f41ec4c43bdefc.png)   >>> Easily equip insulation pads in the new slot!

![The three types of insulation.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75da80be98e2e6b971f74d9e7e0e1fe89941f823.png)

## About A JEI/REI/EMI/RRV plugin that displays detailed enchantment information. ## Usage - **R key** — view enchantment info for enchanted book - **U key** — view info of exclusive enchantments for enchanted book - **U key on an item** — view all enchantments applicable to it ## Features - **Description** — enchantment effect description (uses `enchantment.namespace.path.desc` translation key) - **Rarity** — with customizable colors - **Max Level** — maximum enchantment level - **Treasure / Tradeable / Curse / Discoverable / Enchanting Table** — enchantment flags - **Applicable Items** — items that accept this enchantment - **Exclusive Enchantments** — mutually exclusive enchantments - **Scrollable Panel** — with mouse wheel and drag support ## Config Configurable in-game: Fabric requires Mod Menu, while Forge and NeoForge use the native mod list config screen. | Option | Default | Description | | --------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- | | Scroll Speed | `1.0` | Panel scroll sensitivity | | Text Scroll Speed | `1.0` | Long text auto-scroll multiplier | | Applicable Item Slots | `4` | Max displayed item slots | | Text Boolean Display | `false` | Use Yes/No instead of symbols | | Show Rarity | `true` | Toggle rarity line | | Show Max Level | `true` | Toggle max level line | | Show Treasure | `true` | Toggle treasure line | | Show Tradeable | `true` | Toggle tradeable line | | Show Curse | `true` | Toggle curse line | | Show Discoverable | `true` | Toggle discoverable line | | Show Enchanting Table | `true` | Toggle enchanting table line | | Rarity Colors | default | Four rarity color values (integer) |

name: Upgradable Tools
summary: Allows you to upgrade your tools, from wood to stone to iron to diamond!
description:
# **Upgradable Tools!**
This mod adds more Smithing Templates, akin to the one that upgrades diamond to netherite, so you never have to discard your beloved tools.

**Recipes:**
- Wooden Upgrade - 7 dirt and 1 plank of any wood.
- Leather Upgrade - 7 dirt and 1 leather.
- Stone Upgrade - 7 planks of any wood and 1 cobblestone.
- Chain Upgrade - 7 leather and 1 chain.
- Gold "Upgrade" - 7 planks of any wood and 1 gold ingot.
- Iron Upgrade - 7 gold nuggets OR 7 cobblestone and 1 iron ingot.
- Diamond Upgrade - 7 iron ingots and 1 diamond.
- Fiery Upgrade - 7 blaze powder and 1 fiery ingot.

**How to use:**\
To apply a specific upgrade, you will need the template and 1 of the desired material. For example, to upgrade from iron to diamond, you would need 1 diamond template, 1 diamond and your iron gear.

**Showcase:**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4P2l3hc8Prs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Random facts:**
- You can upgrade any armour or tools, even modded, into any of the available upgrades - even downgrading if you so wish.
- This mod is very useful when you loot any golden equipment, since gold naturally has a high enchantability, so you will likely have better enchantments after upgrading it.
- We actually have support for Spartan Weaponry! Any tool from Spartan can be upgraded into any of the available templates.
- If you're insane, you can use a Fiery Upgrade to convert 1 steak to 1 hydra chop.


<details>
<summary>Planned Features</summary>

**Planned features: (not yet implemeted)**
- Turtle Helmet upgrade
- Allow application of templates to horse armour
- Twilight Forest
- Thermal Series
- Converting templates between mods (such as Ice and Fire copper -> Thermal Series copper)
- Spartan Shields
- Ice and Fire
- Aquaculture 2's Neptunium
- Mystical Agriculture 
- The Bumblezone

**Currently in development:**
- Mazebreaker (Twilight Forest) - Texture needs doing.
- Horse Armour - Recipes need implementing.

</details>



If there are any other mods you want me to support, or any issues with the mod, please contact me on my Discord, clownfishtremu.

**Can I use this in my modpack?**\
Yes.

name: Vampirism Iron's Spells Compatibility
summary: Vampirism mod now integrated with Iron's Spells Blood magic. Use your blood to reduce cooldowns, use blood ray and bite to restore blood!   Also aware of Holy spells!
description:
# Vampire Spells Addon

Vampire Spells Addon connects Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks with Vampirism and
changes selected spell behavior for vampire players.

## Current behavior

- Ray of Siphoning and Devour restore configurable Vampirism blood to a vampire
  caster from delivered health damage. The amount is observed after absorption
  and other damage processing, excludes overkill by capping it to the target's
  health before the hit, and never requests more blood than the caster can hold.
- By default, a vampire pays mana for every mana-consuming Blood School spell.
  When the full mana price cannot be covered, every such spell except Ray of
  Siphoning falls back to an atomic blood payment and spends no mana. If the
  blood price cannot be paid in full, the spell effect is stopped without a
  partial debit.
- `alwaysUseBloodForVampireBloodSpells = true` changes those non-Ray casts to
  blood-only mode even while mana is available. Creative casts, non-mana cast
  sources, and recasts keep their normal free-resource behavior. Ray of
  Siphoning always keeps its normal mana cost and continues to restore blood.
- Devour's configurable mana multiplier still applies only to vampire casters;
  its scaled final price is also the basis for a blood payment. Every Blood
  School spell cast by a vampire uses
  `vampireBloodSpellCooldownMultiplier`, which defaults to `2/3` for a
  cooldown that is 1.5 times shorter.
- A vampire's Ray of Siphoning animates toward the caster rather than toward the
  target. Its guide text also explains the spell's night-creature origin in all
  languages supported by Iron's Spells.
- Holy spell damage dealt to a Vampirism NPC vampire is doubled regardless of
  who cast it. Delivered holy health damage reflects onto a vampire player
  caster.
- Holy healing damages vampire casters/targets and suppresses the corresponding
  heal. Holy utility spells damage a vampire caster, clear any targeting data
  created during pre-cast checks, and cancel the cast.
- Cast and heal correlation state is bounded and cleared on lifecycle
  boundaries so nested or interrupted actions cannot affect an unrelated later
  action.
- Server-side tuning is stored per world in
  `<world>/serverconfig/vampire_spells_addon-server.toml`.

## Requirements

| Minecraft | Loader | Java | Vampirism | Iron's Spells |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21.1 | NeoForge `>=21.1.200` and `<21.2` | 21 | `>=1.10.7` and `<1.11` | `>=1.21.1-3.14.3` and `<1.21.1-4` |
| 1.20.1 | Forge `>=47.4.0` and `<48` | 17 | `>=1.10.7` and `<1.11` | `>=1.20.1-3.15.0` and `<1.20.1-4` |

## Support development

[Support me with a donation ✨](https://web.tribute.tg/d/Oec)

Your support motivates me to continue developing and maintaining this project. Thanks!

description:
![Veggies Delight Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0048349cd17c03f1d1cb554d18c0c0a5109f76e9.png)
***

# **📜About**

**Veggies Delight** is an add-on for **Farmer's Delight** that introduces a variety of new vegetables and dishes to the game.

***

# 🌾**Features**

*   Adds 7 new vegetables: **Bell Pepper** , **Broccoli** , **Cauliflower , Garlic** , **Sweet Potato** , **Turnip and  Zucchini.**
*   Adds **Dandelion Leaf**, a foragable food item found in **plains** biomes **(Mature Dandelion flowers)**
*   Adds **Depot Houses to village**:
    *   A new structure where it serves as a storage area for various goods.
    *   Each Biome contains unique structure and loot.
*   **Wild Veggies Generation:**
    *   **Bell Pepper** – Found in all **hot biomes** (`#forge:is_hot`), **including deserts.**
    *   **Broccoli** – Found in **birch**, **flower**, **dark**, and **common forests** (temperature: `0.4 – 0.7`)
    *   **Cauliflower** – Grows in **extreme hills**, **taiga**, and **birch forests** (temperature: `0.2 – 0.6`)
    *   **Garlic** – Found in **mega taiga**, **forests**, and **plains** (temperature: `0.3 – 0.8`)
    *   **Sweet Potato** – Found in **extreme hills**, **taiga**, and **birch forests** (temperature: `0.2 – 0.6`)
    *   **Turnip** – Spawns along **rivers** (temperature: `0.2 – 0.89`)
    *   **Zucchini** – Grows in all **hot biomes** (`#forge:is_hot`), **excluding deserts.**
*   Additionally, you can get the **new seeds/veggies** from **villager trades**, **wandering traders** and **most vanilla structures.** (This includes abandoned mineshaft, pillager outposts, villages, simple dungeons and shipwrecks)

🔧 The mod is also fully compatible with **Botany**, **Create**, **CreateAdditions**, **Diet**, and **Serene Seasons** **(and a lot of other mods)**

**Use JEI** and **Appleskin** for a better experience.

***

# ☕ Support Veggies Delight! ❤️

***

# 🔒 Permissions

Modpacks: You are welcome to include Veggies Delight in any public or private modpack. Please provide credit and a link back to the mod’s official page.

**Modifications:** You may create addons or modifications to Veggies Delight as long as they are non-commercial and credit the original mod. If you plan to distribute modified versions, please ensure they are clearly labeled as unofficial.

**Commercial Use:** Veggies Delight is not to be used for commercial purposes. This includes selling the mod, offering it as part of a paid service, or using it in monetized content without permission.

**Attribution:** If you feature Veggies Delight in videos, streams, or other content, please 


Feel free to suggest new ideas or report any bugs on the GitHub repository, or contact me directly.
